items.title: 英國央行不再向市場拋售長債！4880億英鎊QT計畫全面改寫
items.title_en: Bank of England Stops Selling Long‑Term Bonds, Rewrites £488 bn QT Plan
paras: 英國央行(BoE)周四(17日)宣布全面改寫量化緊縮(QT)計畫，將暫停所有英國公債出售至明年4月，並停止向市場拋售超長天期公債，目標在2034年前處理規模達4,880億英鎊(約6,500億美元)的債券投資組合。新制可望減少央行與政府發債爭奪市場需求，消息帶動長天期英債上漲、殖利率下滑。
這項調整與英國央行維持基準利率在3.75%的決定同時公布。央行一方面警告中東戰事造成的通膨壓力可能迫使其升息，另一方面則藉由放慢QT，緩解英國公債市場近期面臨的供給壓力。

4,880億英鎊債券分三路處理

根據尚待敲定的方案，英國央行持有的4,880億英鎊公債將分為三部分處理。其中，1,200億英鎊、於2049年或之後到期的超長天期公債，將永久保留在資產負債表，作為流通鈔票的資產擔保。
另有2,220億英鎊公債將於2034年底前陸續到期，央行不再將到期資金重新投入市場；其餘1,460億英鎊、於2035年至2049年間到期的公債，則預計以每年200億英鎊的速度出售。
英國央行正與財政部研議，不再透過市場標售，而是按市價直接將部分債券出售給英國債務管理局(DMO)，再由後者註銷債券並依市場需求調整政府發債規模。最終安排仍須獲得財政部同意，預計在明年4月前確定。
新制實施後，包括公債自然到期及主動出售在內，英國央行每年平均縮減規模約為460億英鎊，低於過去12個月的700億英鎊。央行貨幣政策委員會(MPC)以9票對0票一致通過新方案。

售債累虧1100億英鎊 長債殖利率應聲下滑

英國央行在2009年至2021年間透過量化寬鬆(QE)買進8,950億英鎊債券，藉此刺激經濟並壓低長期利率，2022年起停止將到期資金再投資，並開始直接向市場出售公債。
不過，央行在利率上升後出售低收益債券，迄今已產生約1,100億英鎊損失，最終由納稅人承擔；英國央行文件原先預估，未來可能再出現約1,000億英鎊損失。自由民主黨、英國改革黨及綠黨均曾呼籲終止QT，或對因高利率獲利的銀行徵收暴利稅，以降低公共財政負擔。
英國央行總裁貝里(Andrew Bailey)表示，新安排可維持貨幣政策獨立性，並透過降低整體成本與風險，提高計畫長期效益。央行認為，QT約使英債殖利率上升25個基點，但部分分析師估計，對30年期殖利率的推升幅度可能接近75個基點。
消息公布後，英國30年期公債殖利率下跌約5個基點至5.80%。由於央行暫停售債，不再於短期內與政府發債競爭買盤，市場供給壓力可望獲得喘息。
paras_en: The Bank of England (BoE) announced on Thursday (17th) that it will completely rewrite its quantitative tightening (QT) programme, suspending all UK government bond sales until April next year and stopping the sale of ultra‑long‑term bonds. The aim is to manage a £488 bn (about US$650 bn) bond portfolio by 2034. The new regime is expected to reduce competition between the BoE and the Treasury for market demand, pushing long‑term UK bond prices higher and yields lower.

This adjustment was announced alongside the BoE’s decision to keep the base rate at 3.75%. The bank warned that inflationary pressure from Middle‑East conflicts could force further rate hikes, while a slower QT would ease the supply pressure currently facing the UK bond market.

The £488 bn of bonds will be handled in three ways. One part, £120 bn of ultra‑long bonds maturing in 2049 or later, will remain permanently on the balance sheet as collateral for circulating currency.

Another £222 bn of bonds will mature by the end of 2034, and the BoE will no longer reinvest the proceeds into the market. The remaining £146 bn of bonds maturing between 2035 and 2049 will be sold at a pace of £20 bn per year.

The BoE is negotiating with the Treasury to sell bonds directly to the UK Debt Management Office (DMO) at market price, after which the DMO will cancel the bonds and adjust the Treasury’s issuance to meet demand. Final approval from the Treasury is required, expected by April next year.

Under the new regime, the BoE will reduce its balance sheet by an average of £46 bn per year, including natural maturities and active sales, a drop from the £70 bn cut over the past 12 months. The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) approved the plan unanimously, 9‑0.

Between 2009 and 2021, the BoE bought £895 bn of bonds under quantitative easing (QE) to stimulate the economy and lower long‑term rates. Since 2022 it has stopped reinvesting maturing funds and has begun selling bonds directly to the market.

However, selling low‑yield bonds after rate hikes has already incurred about £110 bn of losses, ultimately borne by taxpayers. BoE documents originally estimated that another £100 bn of losses could arise. The Liberal Democrats, Reform UK, and the Green Party have called for ending QT or imposing a windfall tax on banks profiting from high rates to ease public finances.

BoE Governor Andrew Bailey said the new arrangement preserves monetary policy independence and, by reducing overall costs and risks, improves the long‑term benefits of the programme. The BoE estimates that QT raises UK bond yields by about 25 basis points, though some analysts predict the lift on 30‑year yields could approach 75 basis points.

After the announcement, the 30‑year UK bond yield fell roughly 5 basis points to 5.80%. With the BoE temporarily halting bond sales and no longer competing with the Treasury for short‑term demand, supply pressure in the market is expected to ease.

items.title: 〈偉訓展望〉AIP拓展無人機、人形機器人等新應用 積極推進2028年上市
items.title_en: Weixun Outlook: AIP Expands into Drones, Humanoid Robots and Other New Applications, Actively Pursuing 2028 IPO
paras: 偉訓(3032-TW)表示，收購全球音圈與振膜龍頭AIP（珀韻）後綜效持續顯現，除了既有的聲學領域擴大布局外，也切入無人機、人形機器人等新應用，並積極推進2028年上市計畫。
偉訓指出，AIP為全球音圈市占率逾6成、音膜市占率超過2成的領導廠商，主要布局車用聲學、專業類揚聲器及消費性音響三大領域，既有車用聲學專案持續穩定出貨，並為多家國際車廠供應核心音圈與音膜產品。
此外，AIP在消費電子與智慧家居領域持續拓展，為Apple、Amazon等品牌智慧音箱主要音圈供應商，同時切入無人機、人形機器人等新應用，為後續營運增添成長動能。
偉訓表示，AIP近年持續推進自動化生產及新材料技術，八代線音圈全製程自動化已進入大量量產階段，有助提升生產效率與競爭優勢；隨營運規模擴大及上市計畫推進，預期可進一步發揮與偉訓多元事業布局的綜效。
paras_en: Weixun (3032-TW) said that after acquiring global voice coil and diaphragm leader AIP (Poyun), the synergies continue to emerge. In addition to expanding its existing acoustic business, it is also entering new applications such as drones and humanoid robots, and is actively advancing its plan to go public in 2028.

Weixun noted that AIP is a leading manufacturer with over 60% market share in voice coils and more than 20% in diaphragms worldwide, focusing on three main areas: automotive acoustics, professional speakers, and consumer audio. Its existing automotive acoustic projects continue to ship steadily, supplying core voice coil and diaphragm products to many international car makers.

In addition, AIP is expanding in consumer electronics and smart home sectors, serving as a primary voice coil supplier for smart speakers of brands such as Apple and Amazon, while also moving into new applications like drones and humanoid robots, adding growth momentum to its future operations.

Weixun said that AIP has been advancing automation and new material technologies in recent years. The fully automated production of its eighth-generation voice coil line has entered large‑scale mass production, helping improve manufacturing efficiency and competitive advantage. As its operating scale grows and the IPO plan progresses, further synergies with Weixun’s diversified business portfolio are expected.

items.title: 中石化力拚轉型切入AI市場 預計首期算力中心規模達20億元
items.title_en: Sinopec Pushes Transformation into AI Market, First Phase Computing Center Expected to Cost NT$2 Billion
paras: 石化業近年受中國產能快速擴張影響，加上戰爭影響油價、全球石化業低迷下，近年也加快轉型腳步，中石化(1314-TW)董事長葛樹人今(17)日表示，中石化近年已逐步降低傳統石化業的比重，聚焦高值化材料，新能源、AI高速通訊及半導體材料為新成長動能，並持續評估AI DC(AI資料中心)建置。中石化也將與外部團隊合作建置AI算力中心，據協力廠商表示，首期規模將達5MW，規模建置將達20億元。
葛樹人指出，全球石化產業經營環境相當辛苦，在中國快速擴充石化產能，使台灣業者面臨成本及價格競爭壓力，加上戰爭及原油波動影響，都增加石化業者負擔，中石化一定要尋找新的發展方向，也鎖定AI資料中心、精細化工及環保再生等方向。
中石化目前已規劃活化已除役約2年的頭份苗栗廠，預期將利用約8.7萬坪土地，既有廠房、發電機組、冷卻設備與台電原有線路，與外部團隊共同建置AI算力中心，第1期為5MW，目前已有潛在算力買主，至於第2其有望擴大至50 MW至100MW，第3期則因廠商合作條件協商仍持續在評估中。
據中石化協力規劃AI算力中心建置的能源廠商表示，中石化首期5MW的建置規模有望達到20億元，以AI算力中心來說，規模並不大，但仍是中石化展現轉型的決策之一。
在合作規模上，中石化主要是提供土地、廠房及設備，土地及廠房採承租方式，由合作夥伴負責籌措資金與建置算力中心，未來也規劃成立合資公司。
目前中石化頭份廠內還有約2.5萬、3萬坪化工廠區，因設備仍具利用價值，已經有半導體業者表達興趣，公司將評估整合出售或合作開發；加上既有的廢水處理設施，將可延伸至環保及水資源再生業務。
葛樹人也表示，中石化的轉型不能只停留在願景，也不能把一次的資產處分視為轉型的完成，公司將在改善石化本業的同時，推動資產活化與高值材料商業化，並持續評估AI DC、環保綠能等新事業發展機會，以具體進展檢驗成果、期盼為股東創造長期價值。
paras_en: The petrochemical industry has been hit by China’s rapid capacity expansion, war‑driven oil price volatility and a global downturn, prompting accelerated transformation. Sinopec (1314‑TW) chairman Ge Shuren said on the 17th that the company has been gradually reducing its reliance on traditional petrochemicals, focusing on high‑value materials, new energy, AI high‑speed communications and semiconductor materials as new growth drivers, and continues to assess the construction of AI data centers. Sinopec will cooperate with external teams to build an AI computing center; according to a partner, the first phase will have a capacity of 5 MW and the project will cost about NT$2 billion.

Ge noted that the global petrochemical business environment is extremely tough. China’s rapid expansion of petrochemical capacity puts Taiwanese firms under cost and price pressure, while wars and crude‑oil fluctuations add further burdens. Sinopec must find new development paths and is targeting AI data centers, fine chemicals and environmental recycling as strategic directions.

Sinopec plans to revitalize its decommissioned Toufen plant in Miaoli, which has been idle for about two years. Using roughly 87,000 ping of land, existing buildings, generators, cooling equipment and Taiwan Power Company’s original power lines, the company will work with external partners to build an AI computing center. Phase 1 will be 5 MW and already has potential compute‑power buyers. Phase 2 could expand to 50‑100 MW, while Phase 3 is still under negotiation with partners.

According to the energy firm assisting Sinopec with the AI computing center plan, the first‑phase 5 MW build‑out could reach a cost of NT$2 billion. While modest in size for an AI computing center, it represents one of Sinopec’s key decisions in its transformation effort.

In the partnership, Sinopec will mainly provide land, buildings and equipment, leasing the land and facilities, while the partner will raise funds and construct the computing center. A joint venture company is also planned for the future.

Within the Toufen site, there remains about 25,000–30,000 ping of chemical plant area whose equipment still holds value. A semiconductor company has shown interest, and Sinopec will evaluate a sale or joint development. Existing wastewater‑treatment facilities can also be leveraged for environmental and water‑resource recycling businesses.

Ge emphasized that Sinopec’s transformation cannot remain a vision alone, nor can a single asset disposal be considered the completion of the shift. While improving its core petrochemical operations, the company will activate assets, commercialize high‑value materials, and continue to assess new ventures such as AI data centers and green‑energy projects, using concrete progress to validate results and create long‑term value for shareholders.

items.title: 〈房產〉利率連凍且對房市釋善意 商仲：商用市場迎戰2.895%收益門檻
items.title_en: [Real Estate] Interest rates remain frozen and show goodwill to the housing market; Commercial broker: Commercial market faces a 2.895% yield threshold
paras: 台灣央行今(17)日召開第三季理監事會，維持政策利率不變，存款準備率也未再調升；不動產信用管制同步釋出調整空間，高力國際不動產業主代表服務部董事黃舒衛表示，這次政策調整反映房市風險結構正在改變。房市現在最大的壓力，已從價格漲跌轉向交屋、去化與建商現金流、財務風險。
但商用不動產市場方面，商用不動產則面臨收益率重新定錨。黃舒衛指出，依現行規範，壽險業不動產投資收益率門檻明年1月1日起將由2.72%升至2.895%。在台灣央行利率與存準率維持不變之際，壽險資金的投資報酬要求卻同步提高，商用不動產因此迎來另一波再平衡。2.895%，甚3%再加碼，已成為商用不動產的新價格尺標。
台灣央行今天決策放寬第2屋貸款成數從6成到7成，並明確解除建商購地貸款限期動工興建的管制。住宅市場持續降溫之際，台灣央行政策開始將防範「流動性休克」列為重要考量。
高力國際不動產業主代表服務部董事黃舒衛表示，這次政策調整反映房市風險結構正在改變。房市現在最大的壓力，已從價格漲跌轉向交屋、去化與建商現金流、財務風險。
黃舒衛指出，近年新屋供給量從疫情期間約12萬棟，逐步增加至接近18萬棟，大量新屋陸續進入交屋期。建築投資週期與房市景氣週期存在時間差，當供給高峰撞上信用管制，建商現金流便成為市場關鍵變數。尤其2020年啟動信用管制後，又歷經全球降息、量化寬鬆及AI產業擴張，住宅需求與供給版圖重新洗牌。
這波新增供給具有產業聚落與公共建設帶動的區位需求，但建設到位仍有時間差。交屋能否順利完成，牽動的不只是建商營運，也涉及銀行授信資產的安全邊際。
黃舒衛認為，放寬第2屋貸款成數，有助疏通自住市場的交屋出口，同時解除購地貸款的動工期限，主要考量購地蓋款成數仍低，且投資環境、法規趨嚴，建商囤地成本過高，信用資源仍受到明確約束，適度微調可增加流通性，避免誤殺。

房市價格方面，黃舒衛認為從去年開始，無論是新青安排除在銀行法72-2條，或延長換屋協處，乃至將不動產貸款集中度管制交由各銀行自主管理，都顯示央行在衡量各項指標、授信品質後，逐漸放鬆信用資源的投放，預期交易量可望逐步回穩，但價格仍在激烈分化、重新定錨。而量能修復可能快於價格反彈，總價負擔、首購需求與產品去化速度，將重新成為建商定價的三把尺。建商面對的核心課題仍是餘屋去化與降低槓桿，政策提供的是流動性窗口，市場最終仍須靠價格讓利完成出清。
住宅市場等待重新定價，商用不動產則面臨收益率重新定錨。黃舒衛指出，依現行規範，壽險業不動產投資收益率門檻明年1月1日起將由2.72%升至2.895%。在台灣央行利率與存準率維持不變之際，壽險資金的投資報酬要求卻同步提高，商用不動產因此迎來另一波再平衡。2.895%，甚3%再加碼，已成為商用不動產的新價格尺標。

黃舒衛表示，未來數季商辦新增供給仍大，在空置率、租金與免租期承壓的情況下，資產價格必須重新對應收益要求，商辦市場的價格與租金都將面臨重新校準。更值得注意的是，若未來市場定存利率再上調，壽險業不動產投資收益率門檻可能進一步突破3%。屆時可投資產品與區域勢必更加集中，也可能推動壽險資金從傳統商辦購置，轉向重大公共建設、促參、長照醫療、產業園區及海外收益型資產。收益率門檻往上走，資金配置就會跟著換軌，這也將加速商用不動產從單純資產交易，走向產業營運與長期現金流管理。
黃舒衛總結，台灣央行此次「利率連凍、管制微調」，替房市爭取軟著陸窗口。後續市場將呈現交易量逐步修復、價格持續分化的格局；住宅市場的關鍵是交屋與去化，商用市場的關鍵則是收益率與現金流。不動產下一階段的價格發現，將從資金成本延伸到資產品質。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan held its third‑quarter board meeting today (the 17th) and kept the policy rate unchanged, with the reserve requirement ratio also left unchanged. At the same time, the real‑estate credit controls were eased, giving room for adjustment. Huang Shu‑wei, director of the Owner Representative Services Division at Cushman & Wakefield Taiwan, said this policy shift reflects a changing risk structure in the housing market. The biggest pressure on the market now has moved from price fluctuations to delivery, absorption and developers' cash‑flow and financial risks.

In the commercial real‑estate sector, yields are being re‑anchored. Huang noted that under current regulations, the minimum yield requirement for life‑insurance‑company real‑estate investments will rise from 2.72% to 2.895% starting January 1 next year. While the central bank keeps rates and reserve requirements steady, the return expectations of life‑insurance funds rise in tandem, prompting another round of re‑balancing for commercial properties. The 2.895% (and even a 3% add‑on) has become the new price benchmark for commercial real estate.

The central bank today decided to relax the loan‑to‑value ratio for second homes from 60% to 70% and explicitly lifted the restriction that required developers to begin construction within a set period after obtaining land‑purchase loans. As the residential market continues to cool, the central bank is now treating the prevention of a “liquidity shock” as an important policy consideration.

Huang Shu‑wei of Cushman & Wakefield Taiwan said this policy adjustment reflects a changing risk structure in the housing market. The biggest pressure on the market now has moved from price fluctuations to delivery, absorption and developers' cash‑flow and financial risks.

Huang pointed out that new‑home supply has risen from about 120,000 units during the pandemic to nearly 180,000 units in recent years, with a large influx of new homes entering the delivery phase. The construction investment cycle lags behind the housing‑market cycle, so when a supply peak meets tighter credit controls, developers’ cash flow becomes a key market variable. Especially after the credit controls introduced in 2020, followed by global rate cuts, quantitative easing and the expansion of the AI industry, the demand‑supply landscape for housing has been reshuffled.

This wave of new supply is driven by industrial clusters and public‑infrastructure demand, but there remains a time lag before construction is completed. Whether deliveries can be completed smoothly affects not only developers’ operations but also the safety margin of banks’ credit‑asset portfolios.

Huang believes that loosening the loan‑to‑value ratio for second homes will help clear the delivery bottleneck in the owner‑occupied market, while lifting the construction‑start deadline for land‑purchase loans mainly reflects the fact that land‑acquisition financing ratios remain low, and that investment conditions and regulations are tightening, making land‑holding costs too high for developers. Credit resources are still clearly constrained, so a modest tweak can improve liquidity and avoid an inadvertent market kill.

Regarding prices, Huang says that since last year, measures such as the “New Youth” arrangement under Banking Act Article 72‑2, extensions of home‑exchange assistance, and delegating real‑estate loan concentration controls to individual banks have all shown that the central bank, after weighing various indicators and credit quality, is gradually easing the deployment of credit. Transaction volume is expected to recover gradually, but prices remain sharply divided and are being re‑anchored. Volume recovery may outpace price rebounds; total‑price burden, first‑buyer demand and absorption speed will become the three new pricing levers for developers. The core issue for developers remains unsold inventory and leverage reduction; policy provides a liquidity window, but the market must ultimately rely on price concessions to clear supply.

The residential market awaits a re‑pricing, while commercial real estate faces a re‑anchoring of yields. Huang reiterates that under current rules, the minimum yield for life‑insurance‑company real‑estate investments will rise from 2.72% to 2.895% on January 1 next year. With the central bank’s rates and reserve requirements unchanged, the investment‑return demand of life‑insurance funds rises in step, ushering in another round of re‑balancing for commercial properties. The 2.895% (and even a 3% add‑on) has become the new price benchmark for commercial real estate.

Huang says that in the coming quarters, office‑space supply will remain large, and with pressure on vacancy rates, rents and rent‑free periods, asset prices will have to adjust to meet yield requirements. Both office prices and rents will be recalibrated. Moreover, if deposit rates rise further, the yield threshold for life‑insurance‑company real‑estate investments could break the 3% mark. At that point, investable products and regions will become more concentrated, potentially shifting life‑insurance capital from traditional office purchases toward major public projects, public‑private partnerships, long‑term care, medical facilities, industrial parks and overseas yield‑producing assets. As the yield floor climbs, capital allocation will follow, accelerating the transition of commercial real estate from pure asset trading to industry operations and long‑term cash‑flow management.

Huang concludes that the central bank’s “interest‑rate freeze and slight regulatory tweak” creates a soft‑landing window for the housing market. Going forward, the market will show a gradual recovery in transaction volume and continued price divergence; the residential market’s key issues are delivery and absorption, while the commercial market’s are yields and cash flow. The next stage of real‑estate price discovery will extend from funding costs to asset quality.

items.title: 全台住宅地震險投保率僅4成 金管會：房貸還清別急著斷保 年花1350元買心安
items.title_en: Only 40% of Taiwan Homes Insured for Earthquake Risk, Regulators Urge New Homeowners Not to Drop Coverage After Mortgage Paid Off, Annual Premium 1,350 TWD for Peace of Mind
paras: 房屋是多數人一生中最寶貴的資產，但全台有高達6成的住宅完全沒有地震險保障。金管會保險局指出，不少民眾在付清房貸後隨即選擇斷保，讓居家安全曝露於天然災害與火災的巨大風險中。每年保費僅需1350元的住宅地震基本保險，不僅涵蓋建物全損與臨時住宿補助，新制更擴大至紅標危樓即可領取10萬元慰問金。金管會呼籲國人儘速檢視居家保險規劃，補足資產防禦缺口。
根據保險局最新統計，截至今年8月31日止，全台住宅地震基本保險累積投保件數約384萬餘件。若以全台住宅總戶數約961萬戶計算，平均投保率僅約40%，仍有高達6成的住宅處於無地震保險保障的狀態。
保險局主秘劉純斌表示，觀察各縣市投保狀況，投保率高低主要與地區的「房貸戶比例」密切相關。目前住宅火險與地震險的主要投保族群多為銀行房貸戶；然而，許多民眾在房貸清償完畢後，常因疏忽或缺乏續保意識而選擇斷保，導致極大的風險缺口。
保險局強調，今年與明年的宣導重點將針對「貸款還清戶」及「無房貸戶」，持續強化民眾主動投保的意願，打造完整的財務安全網。
住宅火災保險的保障範疇，涵蓋建築物及其內部動產因火災、爆炸等事故造成的損失(建築物以重置成本計算)，並提供第三人責任險，以移轉事故發生時對第三人應負的賠償責任。
體傷與死亡保障方面，每人體傷最高100萬元、每人死亡最高200萬元、每事故體傷死亡最高1,000萬元。財損與期間總額部分，每事故財物損失最高200萬元；保險期間內最高賠償金額為2,400萬元。
此外，住宅火災險亦包含基本颱風及洪水保險。若住宅及內部動產因颱風或洪水淹水直接遭受損失，將依建築物所在區域(全台分為三區)，提供最高新台幣7,000元至9,000元不等的緊急復原基本保障。
在住宅地震基本保險部分，此保險採政策性機制，非強制險，實施全國單一費率，每年保費僅需1,350元。當住宅建築物因地震造成倒塌或不堪居住(達「全損」標準)時，將提供二大保障，建物理賠以重置成本為基礎，最高理賠金150萬元；臨時住宿費用最高給付20萬元。
此外，自去年7月15日起，保障範圍已進一步擴大。若住宅經直轄市或縣市政府張貼「紅色危險標誌」(不得再進入)者，即使未達全損程度，亦可給付10萬元臨時住宿費用，以減輕緊急處置期間的經濟負擔。
媒體關注這項新措施上路到現在，有無理賠案件？劉純斌回應，「從該政策上路以來，賠付件數為零，天佑台灣！」
保險局提醒，由於住宅地震基本保險僅針對建物全損進行理賠，且保障範圍不含動產與裝潢。若民眾的房屋重置成本超過150萬元，或希望獲得動產與裝潢的保障，可依個人需求向產險公司加保「超額地震保險」或「擴大地震保險」。
paras_en: Housing is the most valuable asset for most people, yet up to 60% of homes across Taiwan have no earthquake insurance at all. The Financial Supervisory Commission’s Insurance Bureau notes that many homeowners discontinue coverage as soon as they finish paying their mortgage, leaving their homes exposed to huge risks from natural disasters and fires. A basic residential earthquake policy costing only 1,350 NTD per year covers total building loss and temporary lodging assistance, and the new scheme also expands benefits to a 100,000 NTD consolation payment for buildings marked with a red danger sign. The FSC urges the public to review their home‑insurance plans promptly and close the asset‑protection gap.

According to the latest statistics from the Insurance Bureau, as of August 31 this year the cumulative number of basic residential earthquake policies nationwide was about 3.84 million. Given roughly 9.61 million households in Taiwan, the average coverage rate is only about 40%, meaning that as many as 60% of homes remain without earthquake insurance protection.

Liu Chun‑bin, chief secretary of the Insurance Bureau, said that the variation in coverage rates across counties and cities is closely tied to the proportion of mortgage‑holding households. Currently, the main groups buying fire and earthquake insurance are those with bank mortgages; however, many people, after clearing their loans, neglect to renew coverage or simply lack awareness, creating a large risk gap.

The Bureau emphasized that this year’s and next year’s outreach will focus on “mortgage‑free households” and “non‑mortgage households,” continuously strengthening the public’s willingness to purchase insurance and building a complete financial safety net.

Residential fire insurance covers losses to the building and its contents caused by fire, explosion and similar incidents (the building is valued at replacement cost) and includes third‑party liability coverage to transfer compensation responsibilities for third‑party claims.

For bodily injury and death, the policy provides up to 1 million NTD per person for injury, up to 2 million NTD per person for death, and up to 10 million NTD per incident for combined injury and death. For property loss and period‑of‑loss amounts, the maximum is 2 million NTD per incident, with a total maximum payout of 24 million NTD during the policy period.

In addition, residential fire insurance also includes basic typhoon and flood coverage. If a home and its contents suffer direct damage from a typhoon or flood, emergency restoration assistance of between 7,000 NTD and 9,000 NTD will be provided, depending on the region (Taiwan is divided into three zones).

The basic residential earthquake insurance is a policy‑driven, non‑mandatory scheme that uses a single nationwide rate, with an annual premium of only 1,350 NTD. When a home collapses or becomes uninhabitable due to an earthquake (meeting the “total loss” standard), two major benefits apply: building compensation based on replacement cost up to a maximum of 1.5 million NTD, and temporary lodging assistance up to 200,000 NTD.

Moreover, since July 15 last year, the coverage scope has been further expanded. If a residence is marked with a “red danger sign” by a municipal or county government (indicating no entry allowed), even if it does not meet the total‑loss criteria, a temporary lodging payment of 100,000 NTD will be provided to ease the economic burden during emergency handling.

When asked by the media whether any claims have been filed since the new measure took effect, Liu Chun‑bin replied, “Since the policy was launched, the number of paid claims is zero—heaven bless Taiwan!”

The Insurance Bureau reminds the public that the basic residential earthquake insurance only compensates for total building loss and does not cover contents or interior fittings. If a homeowner’s replacement cost exceeds 1.5 million NTD or they wish to protect contents and fittings, they can purchase additional “excess earthquake insurance” or “expanded earthquake insurance” from property insurers according to their needs.

items.title: 美銀：美公用事業費用漲幅超越整體通膨率 長期價格看升
items.title_en: BofA: US Utility Costs Rise Faster Than Overall Inflation, Long-Term Prices Expected to Increase
paras: 根據美國銀行最新報告指出，受夏季高溫、美國電網現代化及資料中心建置影響，今年夏季美國公用事業帳單漲幅已超越整體通膨率。
今年8月份平均公用事業帳單較去年同期成長5.3%，高於電力與管道瓦斯4%的漲幅，此現象緊隨美國歷史上記錄最高溫的夏季出現。截至2024年，能源帳單約占美國家戶總支出的3%。
報告分析，製造業回流、再工業化與更新老舊基礎建設的需求，正推升部分地區成本。地區間增幅差異顯著，美東東北部因電網投資帶動價格上漲，佛羅里達州則因法規調整與取消颶風復原附加費而有所調降。
今年6月至8月，底特律、巴爾的摩與華盛頓特區的能源成本年增達10%，但聖荷西、奧蘭多與坦帕等地的費用則呈下降趨勢。此外，美國能源資訊署(EIA)預估工商業用電量將成長4%，需持續投資電網，部分成本可能轉嫁給消費者。
雖然民調顯示七成美國人反對在當地興建資料中心，但美國超導公司(American Superconductor)執行長Daniel McGahn受訪時表示，資料中心與晶片廠的基建費用多屬項目建置成本，不一定會直接轉嫁至一般用戶帳單。
美國銀行補充，聖嬰現象帶來的溫和秋冬可能減少採暖需求並帶來短期緩解，但若引發南部暴風雨，則可能增加家戶維修支出。總體而言，電網升級帶來的長期費用壓力預計仍將持續。
paras_en: According to the latest report from Bank of America, due to summer heat, US grid modernization and data center construction, this summer US utility bills have risen faster than overall inflation.

In August this year, the average utility bill grew 5.3% year‑over‑year, outpacing the 4% increase in electricity and natural gas. This phenomenon follows the hottest summer on record in US history. As of 2024, energy bills account for about 3% of total household spending in the United States.

The report analyzes that reshoring manufacturing, re‑industrialization and the need to upgrade aging infrastructure are pushing up costs in some regions. The regional increase varies markedly; the Northeast of the East Coast sees price hikes driven by grid investments, while Florida sees modest declines due to regulatory adjustments and the removal of hurricane‑recovery surcharges.

From June to August this year, energy costs in Detroit, Baltimore and Washington, D.C. rose 10% year‑over‑year, whereas costs in San Jose, Orlando and Tampa showed a downward trend. In addition, the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) forecasts a 4% growth in commercial and industrial electricity consumption, requiring continued grid investment, with some costs potentially passed on to consumers.

Although polls show that 70% of Americans oppose building data centers locally, Daniel McGahn, CEO of American Superconductor, said in an interview that the infrastructure costs of data centers and chip fabs are largely project‑specific and are not necessarily passed directly to ordinary utility bills.

Bank of America added that the mild autumn and winter brought by the El Niño phenomenon may reduce heating demand and provide short‑term relief, but if it triggers storms in the South, household repair expenses could rise. Overall, the long‑term cost pressure from grid upgrades is expected to persist.

items.title: 〈房產〉台灣央行鬆綁房貸管制 賴正鎰：政策轉向精準管理 有利房市軟著陸
items.title_en: Taiwan Central Bank Eases Mortgage Restrictions, Says Policy Shift Toward Precise Management Benefits Housing Market Soft Landing
paras: 台灣央行今(17)日召開理監事聯席會議做出決議，房市信用管制再出現鬆綁。商業總會榮譽理事長、鄉林(5531-TW)董事長賴正鎰表示，這次台灣央行的調整幅度較前次明顯擴大，代表房市經過近兩年的信用管制後，市場資金集中度與投機需求已有明顯降溫，對房市穩健回歸正常秩序具有正面意義。
同時，賴正鎰表示地產業界希望在第四季時，台灣央行能把貸款水龍頭再開更大些，讓高價住宅貸款金額門檻也能滾動修正。
台灣央行今天決議再放寬換屋自住貸款，將自然人第2戶購屋貸款成數上限由6成提高至7成，同時刪除購地貸款「切結於一定期間內動工興建」的規定，改由銀行依授信實務及個案條件，自行訂定動工時程。
賴正鎰指出，第二戶房貸由6成提高至7成，對真正有換屋、改善居住需求的民眾而言，是重要的資金彈性增加；尤其目前房市交易主力已逐漸回歸首購、換屋等自住需求，適度提高貸款成數，可降低民眾換屋時「先買後賣」所面臨的資金壓力，也有助於住宅市場交易恢復合理流動。
賴正鎰認為，這次台灣央行另一項重要調整，是取消購地貸款必須在一定期間內動工的統一性要求，回歸銀行依個案評估。建築開發從土地取得、規劃設計、都市計畫、建照申請到施工，往往受到基地規模、法規審查及市場條件影響，不宜用單一時間表一體適用。改由銀行依建案條件與開發進度進行授信管理，將更符合實際產業運作，也能避免建商為趕期限而被迫調整開發節奏。
不過，賴正鎰也強調，這次政策並非全面解除房市管制，像是高價住宅貸款、法人購屋及其他相關信用限制仍維持不變，顯示台灣央行仍然重視金融風險與資金流向，顯見央行也認同管制有效，才會進入「有條件鬆綁、個案精準管理」的新階段，希望將來也能持續滾動檢討修正及放寬。
paras_en: The Taiwan Central Bank held a joint meeting of directors and supervisors on the 17th and decided to relax mortgage controls again. Lai Cheng-yi, honorary chairman of the Commercial Association and chairman of Xianglin (5531‑TW), said the adjustment this time is noticeably larger than the previous one, indicating that after nearly two years of credit restrictions, market concentration and speculative demand have cooled, which positively supports the housing market’s return to normal order.

At the same time, Lai Cheng‑yi said the real‑estate industry hopes that in the fourth quarter the Central Bank can open the loan faucet wider, allowing the threshold for high‑price residential loans to be rolled out as well.

The Central Bank today decided to further relax the “move‑in” mortgage for second homes, raising the loan-to‑value limit for natural persons from 60% to 70% and deleting the requirement that land purchase loans must be used to start construction within a certain period, instead allowing banks to set construction timelines based on credit practice and individual case conditions.

Lai Cheng‑yi pointed out that raising the second‑home loan-to‑value from 60% to 70% provides important financial flexibility for people who truly need to move or improve their living conditions. With the housing market’s main force gradually returning to first‑time buyers and movers, a moderate increase in loan-to‑value can reduce the financial pressure of “buy first, sell later” and help restore reasonable liquidity in the residential market.

Lai Cheng‑yi believes that another important adjustment this time is the removal of the uniform requirement that land purchase loans must start construction within a set period, returning to case‑by‑case assessment by banks. Construction development—from land acquisition, planning, urban design, building permit application to construction—is often affected by site scale, regulatory review and market conditions, so a single timetable is inappropriate. Allowing banks to manage credit based on project conditions and development progress better reflects actual industry operations and can prevent developers from being forced to adjust their pace to meet deadlines.

However, Lai Cheng‑yi also emphasized that this policy does not fully lift housing market controls. Restrictions on high‑price residential loans, corporate purchases and other related credit limits remain unchanged, showing that the Central Bank still values financial risk and capital flow. The fact that the bank recognizes the effectiveness of controls explains why it has entered a new stage of "conditional easing and precise case management," and it hopes to continue rolling out reviews, adjustments and relaxations in the future.

items.title: 英國央行不跟Fed升息！貝里警告：中東戰火恐逼央行出手
paras: 英國央行(BoE)周四(17日)以6比3票決議維持基準利率在3.75%不變，未跟進聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行(ECB)升息，但對通膨前景的措辭明顯轉趨鷹派，並警告中東戰事若持續推高能源價格，可能迫使央行收緊貨幣政策。
英國央行總裁貝里(Andrew Bailey)表示，全球能源成本上升目前對英國物價與薪資設定的影響仍有限，但市場波動持續愈久，對通膨造成的衝擊就愈大，央行也愈可能需要升息，以確保通膨回落至2%目標。

通膨恐突破4% 政策措辭明顯轉鷹

英國央行表示，自7月發布上一份經濟預測以來，通膨風險進一步偏向上行，近期能源價格走勢已接近央行先前設定的「不利情境」，可能使通膨壓力根深蒂固。
英國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率升至3.1%，為3月以來首度突破3%，主要受到汽油價格年增23%推動。央行目前預估，英國通膨率可能在2027年初略高於4%，相當於官方目標的兩倍，遠高於先前預測的2026年底3.2%高峰。
儘管勞動市場與企業定價尚未顯示持續性物價壓力，但央行認為相關風險正在升高。由於第二輪通膨效應通常延後出現，不能等到明確跡象浮現後才採取行動。
值得注意的是，不只3名主張立即升息的官員態度鷹派，貝里與3名副總裁布里登(Sarah Breeden)、隆巴德利(Clare Lombardelli)及拉姆斯登(Dave Ramsden)，也都在會議紀錄中提到未來提高利率的可能性，顯示貨幣政策委員會(MPC)內部對升息的接受度正在擴大。

三名官員主張預先升息防堵風險

MPC以6票贊成維持利率、3票支持升息1碼至4%，投票結果與7月會議相同。支持升息的官員包括首席經濟學家皮爾(Huw Pill)，以及外部委員葛林(Megan Greene)和曼恩(Catherine Mann)。
曼恩指出，中東戰事反覆延續，已使能源價格升至遠高於7月基準預測的水準。在通膨走勢與第二輪效應充滿不確定性之際，預先升息是較好的風險管理策略，可避免通膨根深蒂固後，被迫採取更緊縮的政策。
葛林則將伊朗戰爭的間接影響、人工智慧(AI)相關供給限制及聖嬰現象列為潛在通膨來源。皮爾表示，升息可在地緣政治衝突與經濟數據雜訊中，明確展現央行維護物價穩定的決心。
不過，施羅德全球經濟主管里斯(David Rees)認為，英國本土通膨仍受控制、薪資成長正在減速，失業率接近5%，顯示勞動市場已有明顯閒置空間，目前經濟並未迫切需要更高利率，財政政策反而是更大的風險。
英國央行同時將第三季經濟成長率預測由0.1%上調至0.4%，但升息警告仍可能對試圖在10月28日預算案公布前提振經濟信心的英國政府形成壓力。

全面暫停售債 重新規畫量化緊縮

英國央行也大幅調整縮減公債投資組合的方式。過去央行會在每年9月公布未來一年的減持規模，如今改為設定長期目標，計畫在2034年前將基於貨幣政策目的持有的英國公債降至零，但仍會保留部分用於支應鈔票發行的超長天期公債。
央行將暫停所有主動售債，2035年前到期的公債原則上會持有至到期，不再直接出售給市場；至於2035年至2049年到期的債券，央行將評估是否出售給英國政府，並預計在明年4月前公布後續安排。
利率決策公布後，交易員降低升息押注，但市場仍完全反映年底前升息1次的可能性，並認為再升1次的機率約為50%。英國公債價格走高，10年期公債殖利率下跌約4個基點至5.2473%，30年期殖利率下滑約7個基點至5.7932%。
這項決定也凸顯英國央行與其他主要央行暫時分道揚鑣。Fed周三完成2023年以來首次升息，歐洲央行上周則進行今年第二次升息，日本央行也被市場預期可能在周五採取行動。

items.title: 〈偉訓展望〉AIP拓展無人機、人形機器人等新應用 積極推進2028年上市
items.title_en: Weixun Outlook: AIP Expands into Drones, Humanoid Robots and Other New Applications, Actively Pursuing 2028 IPO
paras: 偉訓(3032-TW)表示，收購全球音圈與振膜龍頭AIP（珀韻）後綜效持續顯現，除了既有的聲學領域擴大布局外，也切入無人機、人形機器人等新應用，並積極推進2028年上市計畫。
偉訓指出，AIP為全球音圈市占率逾6成、音膜市占率超過2成的領導廠商，主要布局車用聲學、專業類揚聲器及消費性音響三大領域，既有車用聲學專案持續穩定出貨，並為多家國際車廠供應核心音圈與音膜產品。
此外，AIP在消費電子與智慧家居領域持續拓展，為Apple、Amazon等品牌智慧音箱主要音圈供應商，同時切入無人機、人形機器人等新應用，為後續營運增添成長動能。
偉訓表示，AIP近年持續推進自動化生產及新材料技術，八代線音圈全製程自動化已進入大量量產階段，有助提升生產效率與競爭優勢；隨營運規模擴大及上市計畫推進，預期可進一步發揮與偉訓多元事業布局的綜效。
paras_en: Weixun (3032-TW) said that after acquiring global voice coil and diaphragm leader AIP (Poyun), the synergies continue to emerge. In addition to expanding its existing acoustic business, it is also entering new applications such as drones and humanoid robots, and is actively advancing its plan to go public in 2028.

Weixun noted that AIP is a leading manufacturer with over 60% market share in voice coils and more than 20% in diaphragms worldwide, focusing on three main areas: automotive acoustics, professional speakers, and consumer audio. Its existing automotive acoustic projects continue to ship steadily, supplying core voice coil and diaphragm products to many international car makers.

In addition, AIP is expanding in consumer electronics and smart home sectors, serving as a primary voice coil supplier for smart speakers of brands such as Apple and Amazon, while also moving into new applications like drones and humanoid robots, adding growth momentum to its future operations.

Weixun said that AIP has been advancing automation and new material technologies in recent years. The fully automated production of its eighth-generation voice coil line has entered large‑scale mass production, helping improve manufacturing efficiency and competitive advantage. As its operating scale grows and the IPO plan progresses, further synergies with Weixun’s diversified business portfolio are expected.

items.title: 中石化力拚轉型切入AI市場 預計首期算力中心規模達20億元
items.title_en: Sinopec Pushes Transformation into AI Market, First Phase Computing Center Expected to Cost NT$2 Billion
paras: 石化業近年受中國產能快速擴張影響，加上戰爭影響油價、全球石化業低迷下，近年也加快轉型腳步，中石化(1314-TW)董事長葛樹人今(17)日表示，中石化近年已逐步降低傳統石化業的比重，聚焦高值化材料，新能源、AI高速通訊及半導體材料為新成長動能，並持續評估AI DC(AI資料中心)建置。中石化也將與外部團隊合作建置AI算力中心，據協力廠商表示，首期規模將達5MW，規模建置將達20億元。
葛樹人指出，全球石化產業經營環境相當辛苦，在中國快速擴充石化產能，使台灣業者面臨成本及價格競爭壓力，加上戰爭及原油波動影響，都增加石化業者負擔，中石化一定要尋找新的發展方向，也鎖定AI資料中心、精細化工及環保再生等方向。
中石化目前已規劃活化已除役約2年的頭份苗栗廠，預期將利用約8.7萬坪土地，既有廠房、發電機組、冷卻設備與台電原有線路，與外部團隊共同建置AI算力中心，第1期為5MW，目前已有潛在算力買主，至於第2其有望擴大至50 MW至100MW，第3期則因廠商合作條件協商仍持續在評估中。
據中石化協力規劃AI算力中心建置的能源廠商表示，中石化首期5MW的建置規模有望達到20億元，以AI算力中心來說，規模並不大，但仍是中石化展現轉型的決策之一。
在合作規模上，中石化主要是提供土地、廠房及設備，土地及廠房採承租方式，由合作夥伴負責籌措資金與建置算力中心，未來也規劃成立合資公司。
目前中石化頭份廠內還有約2.5萬、3萬坪化工廠區，因設備仍具利用價值，已經有半導體業者表達興趣，公司將評估整合出售或合作開發；加上既有的廢水處理設施，將可延伸至環保及水資源再生業務。
葛樹人也表示，中石化的轉型不能只停留在願景，也不能把一次的資產處分視為轉型的完成，公司將在改善石化本業的同時，推動資產活化與高值材料商業化，並持續評估AI DC、環保綠能等新事業發展機會，以具體進展檢驗成果、期盼為股東創造長期價值。
paras_en: The petrochemical industry has been hit by China’s rapid capacity expansion, war‑driven oil price volatility and a global downturn, prompting accelerated transformation. Sinopec (1314‑TW) chairman Ge Shuren said on the 17th that the company has been gradually reducing its reliance on traditional petrochemicals, focusing on high‑value materials, new energy, AI high‑speed communications and semiconductor materials as new growth drivers, and continues to assess the construction of AI data centers. Sinopec will cooperate with external teams to build an AI computing center; according to a partner, the first phase will have a capacity of 5 MW and the project will cost about NT$2 billion.

Ge noted that the global petrochemical business environment is extremely tough. China’s rapid expansion of petrochemical capacity puts Taiwanese firms under cost and price pressure, while wars and crude‑oil fluctuations add further burdens. Sinopec must find new development paths and is targeting AI data centers, fine chemicals and environmental recycling as strategic directions.

Sinopec plans to revitalize its decommissioned Toufen plant in Miaoli, which has been idle for about two years. Using roughly 87,000 ping of land, existing buildings, generators, cooling equipment and Taiwan Power Company’s original power lines, the company will work with external partners to build an AI computing center. Phase 1 will be 5 MW and already has potential compute‑power buyers. Phase 2 could expand to 50‑100 MW, while Phase 3 is still under negotiation with partners.

According to the energy firm assisting Sinopec with the AI computing center plan, the first‑phase 5 MW build‑out could reach a cost of NT$2 billion. While modest in size for an AI computing center, it represents one of Sinopec’s key decisions in its transformation effort.

In the partnership, Sinopec will mainly provide land, buildings and equipment, leasing the land and facilities, while the partner will raise funds and construct the computing center. A joint venture company is also planned for the future.

Within the Toufen site, there remains about 25,000–30,000 ping of chemical plant area whose equipment still holds value. A semiconductor company has shown interest, and Sinopec will evaluate a sale or joint development. Existing wastewater‑treatment facilities can also be leveraged for environmental and water‑resource recycling businesses.

Ge emphasized that Sinopec’s transformation cannot remain a vision alone, nor can a single asset disposal be considered the completion of the shift. While improving its core petrochemical operations, the company will activate assets, commercialize high‑value materials, and continue to assess new ventures such as AI data centers and green‑energy projects, using concrete progress to validate results and create long‑term value for shareholders.

items.title: 〈房產〉利率連凍且對房市釋善意 商仲：商用市場迎戰2.895%收益門檻
items.title_en: [Real Estate] Interest rates remain frozen and show goodwill to the housing market; Commercial broker: Commercial market faces a 2.895% yield threshold
paras: 台灣央行今(17)日召開第三季理監事會，維持政策利率不變，存款準備率也未再調升；不動產信用管制同步釋出調整空間，高力國際不動產業主代表服務部董事黃舒衛表示，這次政策調整反映房市風險結構正在改變。房市現在最大的壓力，已從價格漲跌轉向交屋、去化與建商現金流、財務風險。
但商用不動產市場方面，商用不動產則面臨收益率重新定錨。黃舒衛指出，依現行規範，壽險業不動產投資收益率門檻明年1月1日起將由2.72%升至2.895%。在台灣央行利率與存準率維持不變之際，壽險資金的投資報酬要求卻同步提高，商用不動產因此迎來另一波再平衡。2.895%，甚3%再加碼，已成為商用不動產的新價格尺標。
台灣央行今天決策放寬第2屋貸款成數從6成到7成，並明確解除建商購地貸款限期動工興建的管制。住宅市場持續降溫之際，台灣央行政策開始將防範「流動性休克」列為重要考量。
高力國際不動產業主代表服務部董事黃舒衛表示，這次政策調整反映房市風險結構正在改變。房市現在最大的壓力，已從價格漲跌轉向交屋、去化與建商現金流、財務風險。
黃舒衛指出，近年新屋供給量從疫情期間約12萬棟，逐步增加至接近18萬棟，大量新屋陸續進入交屋期。建築投資週期與房市景氣週期存在時間差，當供給高峰撞上信用管制，建商現金流便成為市場關鍵變數。尤其2020年啟動信用管制後，又歷經全球降息、量化寬鬆及AI產業擴張，住宅需求與供給版圖重新洗牌。
這波新增供給具有產業聚落與公共建設帶動的區位需求，但建設到位仍有時間差。交屋能否順利完成，牽動的不只是建商營運，也涉及銀行授信資產的安全邊際。
黃舒衛認為，放寬第2屋貸款成數，有助疏通自住市場的交屋出口，同時解除購地貸款的動工期限，主要考量購地蓋款成數仍低，且投資環境、法規趨嚴，建商囤地成本過高，信用資源仍受到明確約束，適度微調可增加流通性，避免誤殺。

房市價格方面，黃舒衛認為從去年開始，無論是新青安排除在銀行法72-2條，或延長換屋協處，乃至將不動產貸款集中度管制交由各銀行自主管理，都顯示央行在衡量各項指標、授信品質後，逐漸放鬆信用資源的投放，預期交易量可望逐步回穩，但價格仍在激烈分化、重新定錨。而量能修復可能快於價格反彈，總價負擔、首購需求與產品去化速度，將重新成為建商定價的三把尺。建商面對的核心課題仍是餘屋去化與降低槓桿，政策提供的是流動性窗口，市場最終仍須靠價格讓利完成出清。
住宅市場等待重新定價，商用不動產則面臨收益率重新定錨。黃舒衛指出，依現行規範，壽險業不動產投資收益率門檻明年1月1日起將由2.72%升至2.895%。在台灣央行利率與存準率維持不變之際，壽險資金的投資報酬要求卻同步提高，商用不動產因此迎來另一波再平衡。2.895%，甚3%再加碼，已成為商用不動產的新價格尺標。

黃舒衛表示，未來數季商辦新增供給仍大，在空置率、租金與免租期承壓的情況下，資產價格必須重新對應收益要求，商辦市場的價格與租金都將面臨重新校準。更值得注意的是，若未來市場定存利率再上調，壽險業不動產投資收益率門檻可能進一步突破3%。屆時可投資產品與區域勢必更加集中，也可能推動壽險資金從傳統商辦購置，轉向重大公共建設、促參、長照醫療、產業園區及海外收益型資產。收益率門檻往上走，資金配置就會跟著換軌，這也將加速商用不動產從單純資產交易，走向產業營運與長期現金流管理。
黃舒衛總結，台灣央行此次「利率連凍、管制微調」，替房市爭取軟著陸窗口。後續市場將呈現交易量逐步修復、價格持續分化的格局；住宅市場的關鍵是交屋與去化，商用市場的關鍵則是收益率與現金流。不動產下一階段的價格發現，將從資金成本延伸到資產品質。
paras_en: The Central Bank of Taiwan held its third‑quarter board meeting today (the 17th) and kept the policy rate unchanged, with the reserve requirement ratio also left unchanged. At the same time, the real‑estate credit controls were eased, giving room for adjustment. Huang Shu‑wei, director of the Owner Representative Services Division at Cushman & Wakefield Taiwan, said this policy shift reflects a changing risk structure in the housing market. The biggest pressure on the market now has moved from price fluctuations to delivery, absorption and developers' cash‑flow and financial risks.

In the commercial real‑estate sector, yields are being re‑anchored. Huang noted that under current regulations, the minimum yield requirement for life‑insurance‑company real‑estate investments will rise from 2.72% to 2.895% starting January 1 next year. While the central bank keeps rates and reserve requirements steady, the return expectations of life‑insurance funds rise in tandem, prompting another round of re‑balancing for commercial properties. The 2.895% (and even a 3% add‑on) has become the new price benchmark for commercial real estate.

The central bank today decided to relax the loan‑to‑value ratio for second homes from 60% to 70% and explicitly lifted the restriction that required developers to begin construction within a set period after obtaining land‑purchase loans. As the residential market continues to cool, the central bank is now treating the prevention of a “liquidity shock” as an important policy consideration.

Huang Shu‑wei of Cushman & Wakefield Taiwan said this policy adjustment reflects a changing risk structure in the housing market. The biggest pressure on the market now has moved from price fluctuations to delivery, absorption and developers' cash‑flow and financial risks.

Huang pointed out that new‑home supply has risen from about 120,000 units during the pandemic to nearly 180,000 units in recent years, with a large influx of new homes entering the delivery phase. The construction investment cycle lags behind the housing‑market cycle, so when a supply peak meets tighter credit controls, developers’ cash flow becomes a key market variable. Especially after the credit controls introduced in 2020, followed by global rate cuts, quantitative easing and the expansion of the AI industry, the demand‑supply landscape for housing has been reshuffled.

This wave of new supply is driven by industrial clusters and public‑infrastructure demand, but there remains a time lag before construction is completed. Whether deliveries can be completed smoothly affects not only developers’ operations but also the safety margin of banks’ credit‑asset portfolios.

Huang believes that loosening the loan‑to‑value ratio for second homes will help clear the delivery bottleneck in the owner‑occupied market, while lifting the construction‑start deadline for land‑purchase loans mainly reflects the fact that land‑acquisition financing ratios remain low, and that investment conditions and regulations are tightening, making land‑holding costs too high for developers. Credit resources are still clearly constrained, so a modest tweak can improve liquidity and avoid an inadvertent market kill.

Regarding prices, Huang says that since last year, measures such as the “New Youth” arrangement under Banking Act Article 72‑2, extensions of home‑exchange assistance, and delegating real‑estate loan concentration controls to individual banks have all shown that the central bank, after weighing various indicators and credit quality, is gradually easing the deployment of credit. Transaction volume is expected to recover gradually, but prices remain sharply divided and are being re‑anchored. Volume recovery may outpace price rebounds; total‑price burden, first‑buyer demand and absorption speed will become the three new pricing levers for developers. The core issue for developers remains unsold inventory and leverage reduction; policy provides a liquidity window, but the market must ultimately rely on price concessions to clear supply.

The residential market awaits a re‑pricing, while commercial real estate faces a re‑anchoring of yields. Huang reiterates that under current rules, the minimum yield for life‑insurance‑company real‑estate investments will rise from 2.72% to 2.895% on January 1 next year. With the central bank’s rates and reserve requirements unchanged, the investment‑return demand of life‑insurance funds rises in step, ushering in another round of re‑balancing for commercial properties. The 2.895% (and even a 3% add‑on) has become the new price benchmark for commercial real estate.

Huang says that in the coming quarters, office‑space supply will remain large, and with pressure on vacancy rates, rents and rent‑free periods, asset prices will have to adjust to meet yield requirements. Both office prices and rents will be recalibrated. Moreover, if deposit rates rise further, the yield threshold for life‑insurance‑company real‑estate investments could break the 3% mark. At that point, investable products and regions will become more concentrated, potentially shifting life‑insurance capital from traditional office purchases toward major public projects, public‑private partnerships, long‑term care, medical facilities, industrial parks and overseas yield‑producing assets. As the yield floor climbs, capital allocation will follow, accelerating the transition of commercial real estate from pure asset trading to industry operations and long‑term cash‑flow management.

Huang concludes that the central bank’s “interest‑rate freeze and slight regulatory tweak” creates a soft‑landing window for the housing market. Going forward, the market will show a gradual recovery in transaction volume and continued price divergence; the residential market’s key issues are delivery and absorption, while the commercial market’s are yields and cash flow. The next stage of real‑estate price discovery will extend from funding costs to asset quality.

items.title: 全台住宅地震險投保率僅4成 金管會：房貸還清別急著斷保 年花1350元買心安
items.title_en: Only 40% of Taiwan Homes Insured for Earthquake Risk, Regulators Urge New Homeowners Not to Drop Coverage After Mortgage Paid Off, Annual Premium 1,350 TWD for Peace of Mind
paras: 房屋是多數人一生中最寶貴的資產，但全台有高達6成的住宅完全沒有地震險保障。金管會保險局指出，不少民眾在付清房貸後隨即選擇斷保，讓居家安全曝露於天然災害與火災的巨大風險中。每年保費僅需1350元的住宅地震基本保險，不僅涵蓋建物全損與臨時住宿補助，新制更擴大至紅標危樓即可領取10萬元慰問金。金管會呼籲國人儘速檢視居家保險規劃，補足資產防禦缺口。
根據保險局最新統計，截至今年8月31日止，全台住宅地震基本保險累積投保件數約384萬餘件。若以全台住宅總戶數約961萬戶計算，平均投保率僅約40%，仍有高達6成的住宅處於無地震保險保障的狀態。
保險局主秘劉純斌表示，觀察各縣市投保狀況，投保率高低主要與地區的「房貸戶比例」密切相關。目前住宅火險與地震險的主要投保族群多為銀行房貸戶；然而，許多民眾在房貸清償完畢後，常因疏忽或缺乏續保意識而選擇斷保，導致極大的風險缺口。
保險局強調，今年與明年的宣導重點將針對「貸款還清戶」及「無房貸戶」，持續強化民眾主動投保的意願，打造完整的財務安全網。
住宅火災保險的保障範疇，涵蓋建築物及其內部動產因火災、爆炸等事故造成的損失(建築物以重置成本計算)，並提供第三人責任險，以移轉事故發生時對第三人應負的賠償責任。
體傷與死亡保障方面，每人體傷最高100萬元、每人死亡最高200萬元、每事故體傷死亡最高1,000萬元。財損與期間總額部分，每事故財物損失最高200萬元；保險期間內最高賠償金額為2,400萬元。
此外，住宅火災險亦包含基本颱風及洪水保險。若住宅及內部動產因颱風或洪水淹水直接遭受損失，將依建築物所在區域(全台分為三區)，提供最高新台幣7,000元至9,000元不等的緊急復原基本保障。
在住宅地震基本保險部分，此保險採政策性機制，非強制險，實施全國單一費率，每年保費僅需1,350元。當住宅建築物因地震造成倒塌或不堪居住(達「全損」標準)時，將提供二大保障，建物理賠以重置成本為基礎，最高理賠金150萬元；臨時住宿費用最高給付20萬元。
此外，自去年7月15日起，保障範圍已進一步擴大。若住宅經直轄市或縣市政府張貼「紅色危險標誌」(不得再進入)者，即使未達全損程度，亦可給付10萬元臨時住宿費用，以減輕緊急處置期間的經濟負擔。
媒體關注這項新措施上路到現在，有無理賠案件？劉純斌回應，「從該政策上路以來，賠付件數為零，天佑台灣！」
保險局提醒，由於住宅地震基本保險僅針對建物全損進行理賠，且保障範圍不含動產與裝潢。若民眾的房屋重置成本超過150萬元，或希望獲得動產與裝潢的保障，可依個人需求向產險公司加保「超額地震保險」或「擴大地震保險」。
paras_en: Housing is the most valuable asset for most people, yet up to 60% of homes across Taiwan have no earthquake insurance at all. The Financial Supervisory Commission’s Insurance Bureau notes that many homeowners discontinue coverage as soon as they finish paying their mortgage, leaving their homes exposed to huge risks from natural disasters and fires. A basic residential earthquake policy costing only 1,350 NTD per year covers total building loss and temporary lodging assistance, and the new scheme also expands benefits to a 100,000 NTD consolation payment for buildings marked with a red danger sign. The FSC urges the public to review their home‑insurance plans promptly and close the asset‑protection gap.

According to the latest statistics from the Insurance Bureau, as of August 31 this year the cumulative number of basic residential earthquake policies nationwide was about 3.84 million. Given roughly 9.61 million households in Taiwan, the average coverage rate is only about 40%, meaning that as many as 60% of homes remain without earthquake insurance protection.

Liu Chun‑bin, chief secretary of the Insurance Bureau, said that the variation in coverage rates across counties and cities is closely tied to the proportion of mortgage‑holding households. Currently, the main groups buying fire and earthquake insurance are those with bank mortgages; however, many people, after clearing their loans, neglect to renew coverage or simply lack awareness, creating a large risk gap.

The Bureau emphasized that this year’s and next year’s outreach will focus on “mortgage‑free households” and “non‑mortgage households,” continuously strengthening the public’s willingness to purchase insurance and building a complete financial safety net.

Residential fire insurance covers losses to the building and its contents caused by fire, explosion and similar incidents (the building is valued at replacement cost) and includes third‑party liability coverage to transfer compensation responsibilities for third‑party claims.

For bodily injury and death, the policy provides up to 1 million NTD per person for injury, up to 2 million NTD per person for death, and up to 10 million NTD per incident for combined injury and death. For property loss and period‑of‑loss amounts, the maximum is 2 million NTD per incident, with a total maximum payout of 24 million NTD during the policy period.

In addition, residential fire insurance also includes basic typhoon and flood coverage. If a home and its contents suffer direct damage from a typhoon or flood, emergency restoration assistance of between 7,000 NTD and 9,000 NTD will be provided, depending on the region (Taiwan is divided into three zones).

The basic residential earthquake insurance is a policy‑driven, non‑mandatory scheme that uses a single nationwide rate, with an annual premium of only 1,350 NTD. When a home collapses or becomes uninhabitable due to an earthquake (meeting the “total loss” standard), two major benefits apply: building compensation based on replacement cost up to a maximum of 1.5 million NTD, and temporary lodging assistance up to 200,000 NTD.

Moreover, since July 15 last year, the coverage scope has been further expanded. If a residence is marked with a “red danger sign” by a municipal or county government (indicating no entry allowed), even if it does not meet the total‑loss criteria, a temporary lodging payment of 100,000 NTD will be provided to ease the economic burden during emergency handling.

When asked by the media whether any claims have been filed since the new measure took effect, Liu Chun‑bin replied, “Since the policy was launched, the number of paid claims is zero—heaven bless Taiwan!”

The Insurance Bureau reminds the public that the basic residential earthquake insurance only compensates for total building loss and does not cover contents or interior fittings. If a homeowner’s replacement cost exceeds 1.5 million NTD or they wish to protect contents and fittings, they can purchase additional “excess earthquake insurance” or “expanded earthquake insurance” from property insurers according to their needs.

items.title: 〈房產〉台灣央行鬆綁房貸管制 賴正鎰：政策轉向精準管理 有利房市軟著陸
items.title_en: Taiwan Central Bank Eases Mortgage Restrictions, Says Policy Shift Toward Precise Management Benefits Housing Market Soft Landing
paras: 台灣央行今(17)日召開理監事聯席會議做出決議，房市信用管制再出現鬆綁。商業總會榮譽理事長、鄉林(5531-TW)董事長賴正鎰表示，這次台灣央行的調整幅度較前次明顯擴大，代表房市經過近兩年的信用管制後，市場資金集中度與投機需求已有明顯降溫，對房市穩健回歸正常秩序具有正面意義。
同時，賴正鎰表示地產業界希望在第四季時，台灣央行能把貸款水龍頭再開更大些，讓高價住宅貸款金額門檻也能滾動修正。
台灣央行今天決議再放寬換屋自住貸款，將自然人第2戶購屋貸款成數上限由6成提高至7成，同時刪除購地貸款「切結於一定期間內動工興建」的規定，改由銀行依授信實務及個案條件，自行訂定動工時程。
賴正鎰指出，第二戶房貸由6成提高至7成，對真正有換屋、改善居住需求的民眾而言，是重要的資金彈性增加；尤其目前房市交易主力已逐漸回歸首購、換屋等自住需求，適度提高貸款成數，可降低民眾換屋時「先買後賣」所面臨的資金壓力，也有助於住宅市場交易恢復合理流動。
賴正鎰認為，這次台灣央行另一項重要調整，是取消購地貸款必須在一定期間內動工的統一性要求，回歸銀行依個案評估。建築開發從土地取得、規劃設計、都市計畫、建照申請到施工，往往受到基地規模、法規審查及市場條件影響，不宜用單一時間表一體適用。改由銀行依建案條件與開發進度進行授信管理，將更符合實際產業運作，也能避免建商為趕期限而被迫調整開發節奏。
不過，賴正鎰也強調，這次政策並非全面解除房市管制，像是高價住宅貸款、法人購屋及其他相關信用限制仍維持不變，顯示台灣央行仍然重視金融風險與資金流向，顯見央行也認同管制有效，才會進入「有條件鬆綁、個案精準管理」的新階段，希望將來也能持續滾動檢討修正及放寬。
paras_en: The Taiwan Central Bank held a joint meeting of directors and supervisors on the 17th and decided to relax mortgage controls again. Lai Cheng-yi, honorary chairman of the Commercial Association and chairman of Xianglin (5531‑TW), said the adjustment this time is noticeably larger than the previous one, indicating that after nearly two years of credit restrictions, market concentration and speculative demand have cooled, which positively supports the housing market’s return to normal order.

At the same time, Lai Cheng‑yi said the real‑estate industry hopes that in the fourth quarter the Central Bank can open the loan faucet wider, allowing the threshold for high‑price residential loans to be rolled out as well.

The Central Bank today decided to further relax the “move‑in” mortgage for second homes, raising the loan-to‑value limit for natural persons from 60% to 70% and deleting the requirement that land purchase loans must be used to start construction within a certain period, instead allowing banks to set construction timelines based on credit practice and individual case conditions.

Lai Cheng‑yi pointed out that raising the second‑home loan-to‑value from 60% to 70% provides important financial flexibility for people who truly need to move or improve their living conditions. With the housing market’s main force gradually returning to first‑time buyers and movers, a moderate increase in loan-to‑value can reduce the financial pressure of “buy first, sell later” and help restore reasonable liquidity in the residential market.

Lai Cheng‑yi believes that another important adjustment this time is the removal of the uniform requirement that land purchase loans must start construction within a set period, returning to case‑by‑case assessment by banks. Construction development—from land acquisition, planning, urban design, building permit application to construction—is often affected by site scale, regulatory review and market conditions, so a single timetable is inappropriate. Allowing banks to manage credit based on project conditions and development progress better reflects actual industry operations and can prevent developers from being forced to adjust their pace to meet deadlines.

However, Lai Cheng‑yi also emphasized that this policy does not fully lift housing market controls. Restrictions on high‑price residential loans, corporate purchases and other related credit limits remain unchanged, showing that the Central Bank still values financial risk and capital flow. The fact that the bank recognizes the effectiveness of controls explains why it has entered a new stage of "conditional easing and precise case management," and it hopes to continue rolling out reviews, adjustments and relaxations in the future.

items.title: 無畏升息波動 法人提解方：多重資產搭配股債更抗震
items.title_en: Undaunted by Rate Hike Volatility: Institutional Strategies Suggest Multi‑Asset Mix of Equities and Bonds for Greater Resilience
paras: 美國聯準會昨(16)如預期升息一碼，政策點陣圖亦顯示高利率環境可能延續更長時間，消息一出引發全球資本市場的高度關注。富邦投信認為，升一碼符合市場預期，儘管市場短期仍具波動性，但不妨利用多重資產搭配股債布局，分散市場波動，將有助第四季資產之預期表現。
面對升息對市場帶來的波動，富邦固定收益主管暨富裕商機多重資產基金擬任經理人薛博升分析指出，雖然短期內利率上揚會使債券價格承壓，但從中長期的資產配置角度來看，債市的高殖利率已展現出近年難得的投資價值；然而升息主要目的為抑制通膨，投資人後續仍應持續關注通膨數據表現及政策效果是否發揮。
針對股市，富邦主權投資部主管高晧欣表示，短線對於多頭看法仍不變，相對7月底大跌之加權指數評價同樣落在約21倍本益比附近；與3月期間市場相比，本波跌勢在評價面上似已趨於滿足。
高晧欣認為，前期美國股指承壓已經很大程度反應市場對於FED鷹派升息的利空預期，聯準會確認升息後有機會因為不確定性落地，加上AI產業基本面需求持續強勁，帶動市場風險偏好顯著回升，對科技股持審慎樂觀的看法。在投資策略上，則相對看好包括散熱、AI零組件、半導體設備、TPU ASIC相關、測試介面等次產業，AI高科技仍是後續關注焦點。
除股市看多之外，主動富邦複合收益ETF(00983D-TW)經理人游陳達表示，隨著基準利率來到相對高檔，債券收益率(Yield)同步推升，對於追求穩定現金流與長期避險資產的機構法人及一般投資人而言，當前反而是分批布局高品質債券ETF的策略時機。
游陳達建議，在升息循環尾聲或高利率震盪期間，投資人可採用「長短債搭配」與「多貨幣配置」的雙軌戰略。短天期債券受利率波動影響較小，能提供相對穩健的收益防護；而高評級長天期公債與投資級公司債，則可在未來利率政策轉折時，享有資本利得的潛在空間，若無法自行配置，不妨利用主動式複合債ETF(00983D-TW)一次布局到位。
總結來說，儘管昨夜升息一碼短期內添增了市場不確定性，但隨著債市殖利率重回吸引力區間，富邦投信呼籲投資人應理性看待市場表現，短線切勿躁進殺出，應妥善調整債券組合天期與信評結構，並利用市場震盪之際，逐步增持看好AI創新科技之海內外股票ETF如00662、006208、00892等，建構更具抗震力的資產配置。

paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised rates by one quarter point yesterday (the 16th) as expected, and its policy dot‑plot indicates that a high‑interest‑rate environment may persist longer. The news sparked intense focus across global capital markets. Fubon Asset Management believes the hike aligns with market expectations; although short‑term volatility remains, employing a multi‑asset mix of equities and bonds to diversify market swings should help the fourth‑quarter asset performance outlook.

Facing the market turbulence caused by rate hikes, Fubon Fixed‑Income head and prospective manager of the Fubon Wealth Opportunities Multi‑Asset Fund, Hsieh Po‑Sheng, noted that while rising rates put short‑term pressure on bond prices, from a medium‑ to long‑term allocation perspective the bond market’s high yields now offer a rare investment value. Nonetheless, the primary aim of rate hikes is to curb inflation, so investors should continue monitoring inflation data and the effectiveness of policy measures.

Regarding equities, Fubon Sovereign Investment Division chief Kao Hao‑Hsin said his short‑term bullish view remains unchanged, with the weighted index’s valuation after the late‑July plunge still around a 21‑times price‑to‑earnings multiple. Compared with the market in March, the current decline appears to have satisfied valuation concerns.

Kao Hao‑Xin believes the earlier pressure on U.S. indices largely reflected market expectations of the Fed’s hawkish tightening. With the Fed’s rate hike now confirmed, uncertainty may ease, and continued strong demand in the AI sector has revived risk appetite, leading him to hold a cautiously optimistic stance on tech stocks. Strategically, he favors downstream segments such as cooling solutions, AI components, semiconductor equipment, TPU ASICs, and test interfaces, keeping AI high‑tech as a focal point.

Beyond a bullish equity outlook, active manager You Chen‑Da of the Fubon Composite Yield ETF (00983D‑TW) said that as the benchmark rate reaches relatively high levels, bond yields have risen in tandem. For institutional investors, corporate clients and retail investors seeking stable cash flow and long‑term hedging assets, now is actually an opportune moment to stagger purchases of high‑quality bond ETFs.

You Chen‑Da recommends that during the tail end of the rate‑hike cycle or periods of high‑rate volatility, investors adopt a dual‑track strategy of “short‑and‑long bond pairing” and “multi‑currency allocation.” Short‑term bonds are less sensitive to rate swings and provide steadier returns, while high‑grade long‑term sovereign and investment‑grade corporate bonds can offer capital‑gain potential when policy pivots. If investors cannot build such a portfolio themselves, they may use the active composite bond ETF (00983D‑TW) for a one‑stop allocation.

In summary, although yesterday’s one‑point hike added short‑term uncertainty, the return of attractive bond yields prompts Fubon Asset Management to urge investors to view market performance rationally, avoid hasty short‑term exits, and appropriately adjust bond maturities and credit quality. They should also use market swings to gradually increase holdings of AI‑innovation equity ETFs such as 00662, 006208 and 00892, building a more shock‑resistant asset mix.

items.title: 〈偉訓展望〉AI應用百花齊放 Q4營運動能升溫明年再向上
items.title_en: Weixin Outlook: AI Applications Bloom, Q4 Operational Momentum Heats Up, Growth to Accelerate Next Year
paras: 機殼電源廠偉訓(3032-TW)表示，受惠AI機櫃、散熱及高速網通等產品放量、新品接力，第四季出營運動能升溫，全年營收可望維持雙位數成長，明年營運將進一步向上，毛利率也將同步提升。
偉訓指出，AI相關產品布局持續開花結果，其中機櫃業務成長最為顯著，目前已占整體營收約三成，與系統商合作的美系大型資料中心AI機櫃自第二季出貨、第三季持續放量，訂單能見度已看到2027年第一季；與國內AI伺服器系統商合作開發的AI水冷機櫃則預計第四季量產。
散熱方面，偉訓與美系前四大CSP合作開發新一代ASIC、DPU專屬散熱模組，已通過客戶熱阻與抗壓驗證，預計第四季量產；液冷分歧管也已進入送樣測試，持續擴大液冷布局。
此外，偉訓正進行輝達(NVDA-US)NVIDIA MGX系列機殼生產，預計第四季放量；新世代1.6T交換器機箱預計2027年第一季出貨，與全球前四大EMS廠合作開發的光纖光模組組件則已於9月出貨，第四季進一步放量，成為明年重要成長動能。
電源產品方面，偉訓已取得一線品牌2800W、3000W工作站電源專案，預計2027年第二季量產；同時電競電源市場回溫，新專案陸續推進，公司預估電競相關產品2027年將較今年雙位數成長。
paras_en: Weixin (3032-TW), a chassis and power supply manufacturer, said that benefiting from the scaling of AI cabinets, cooling and high‑speed networking products as well as new product rollouts, operational momentum will heat up in the fourth quarter, and full‑year revenue is expected to maintain double‑digit growth, with operations further improving next year and gross margins rising in tandem.

Weixin noted that its AI‑related product lineup continues to bear fruit, with cabinet sales showing the most significant growth and now accounting for about 30% of total revenue. AI cabinets for large U.S. data centers, built with system integrators, began shipping in Q2 and have been scaling in Q3, with order visibility extending to Q1 2027. AI water‑cooled cabinets co‑developed with domestic AI server vendors are slated for mass production in Q4.

On the cooling side, Weixin is working with the four major U.S. cloud service providers to develop next‑generation ASIC and DPU‑specific cooling modules, which have passed customer thermal‑resistance and pressure‑resistance tests and are expected to enter mass production in Q4. The liquid‑cooling manifold has also entered sample‑testing phase as the company expands its liquid‑cooling portfolio.

In addition, Weixin is producing NVIDIA’s (NVDA-US) MGX series chassis, with volume ramp‑up expected in Q4. A next‑generation 1.6‑terabit switch chassis is slated for shipment in Q1 2027, and fiber‑optic module components co‑developed with the world’s top four EMS firms were shipped in September and will see further volume increase in Q4, becoming a key growth driver for next year.

Regarding power products, Weixin has secured projects for high‑end 2800 W and 3000 W workstation power supplies from a leading brand, with mass production planned for Q2 2027. At the same time, the gaming‑power‑supply market is warming, new projects are progressing, and the company estimates that gaming‑related products will grow by double‑digit percentages in 2027 compared with this year.

items.title: 〈央行理監事會〉預售交屋、換屋壓力可望紓解 H2房市量能有望溫和回升
items.title_en: Central Bank Board Meeting: Pre‑sale Delivery and Home‑switching Pressures Expected to Ease, H2 Housing Market Volume Likely to Recover Moderately
paras: 台灣央行今(17)日召開第三季理監事會議，不僅利率「連10凍」並調整自然人第2戶購屋貸款最高成數上限，由6成調升為7成。等於是對台灣房市選擇性信用管制則進行局部微調， 房仲業者指出，此舉短期可望提升換屋族及預售屋買方的交屋能力，讓新屋交屋潮更順暢。
同時，台灣央行的此一對房市選擇性信用管小鬆綁，房仲業者認為降低預售屋解約及建商交屋延遲的風險。
但信義房屋(9940-TW)指出，信用管制的鬆綁一方面有利於房市信心復甦，且對換屋族與預售交屋族群確有幫助，但市場仍以自用當道，房價反映空間有限。
永慶房屋研展中心副理陳金萍表示，央行本季維持政策利率不變，顯示在國內經濟成長動能強勁、通膨仍需留意之際，貨幣政策延續審慎立場；同時，央行認為不動產放款集中度逐漸下降，加上無自用住宅民眾購屋貸款占購置住宅貸款的比重持續增加，房市投機炒作明顯減少，民眾看漲房價的預期心理也有趨緩的狀況，因此，僅微調信用管制，讓第二戶貸款上限由六成提高至七成。
陳金萍補充，由於近兩年大量預售屋即將陸續完工交屋，部分購屋人在簽約時尚未受到嚴格信用管制影響，交屋時卻因名下已有房屋，被認定為第二戶貸款，必須增加大筆自備款，甚至面臨籌資困難、延後交屋或違約風險。因，此次調整可視為針對預售交屋及換屋需求的政策精準微調，有助於解決消費者實際面臨的資金痛點。
陳金萍說，從房市影響來看，第2戶貸款成數提高至七成，短期可望提升換屋族及預售屋買方的交屋能力，讓新屋交屋潮更順暢，並降低預售屋解約及建商交屋延遲的風險。而對於中古屋市場而言，部分原本因貸款限制而延後購屋的換屋需求，可望逐步回到市場，增加交易動能。
陳金萍指出，整體而言，放鬆第2戶貸款成數上限對房市信心與交易量的確具有正面效果，但較可能帶動自住換屋及既有預售屋交屋需求，不宜解讀為信用管制全面退場。後續房市交易仍受銀行核貸態度、利率及排撥時程影響，市場交易仍以首購、換屋及中長期置產需求為主，預估後續交易量有望溫和回升，房價則持續呈現區域及產品分化。
信義房屋指出， 台灣央行此次理監事會議後決議利率條件不變，且有感房市交易持續降溫且投機炒作減少，民眾看漲房價預期心理趨緩，考量選擇性信用管制成效持續顯現，此次將第2戶房貸成數上限從6成拉高至7成，一方面有利於房市信心復甦，另一方面換屋族多了1成貸款資金也可能增加意願。
台灣央行此次有兩項放寬措施，包括進一步協助自然人第2戶貸款供家人或自己購屋自住之需求，調整自然人第2戶購屋貸款最高成數上限，由6成調升為7成，且未來刪除購地貸款有關「切結於一定期間內動工興建」之規定，回歸銀行依授信實務辦理。
信義房屋不動產企研室專案經理曾敬德表示，第2戶放寬至7成算是對於房市有利的政策鬆綁，換屋族的確可能因為可以多借1成的資金，而增加購屋意願，以2500萬元的房屋為例，本來要準備1000萬元，現在手上自備款可以少準備250萬元，對於部分換屋族與預售交屋的族群的確有些幫助，不過現在房市仍處於自用當道的市場，預料房價反映空間應該有限。

信義代銷永續研展組童莉婷協理表示，對預售市場而言，買方資金條件與建商推案環境皆有進一步改善。利率維持不變，使購屋族資金成本未再增加；第2戶貸款成數放寬，則有助提升自住與換屋族群的資金調度彈性，對新案來人與成交轉換可望形成正面支撐。另一方面，購地貸款動工期限相關規範同步放寬，也讓建商在土地開發、推案時程及資金配置上更具彈性，有助降低供給端壓力。整體而言，本次政策調整有助改善預售市場買賣雙方的信心與決策條件，預期後續市場仍將回歸個案表現，總價控制、產品規劃及區域基本面佳的建案，去化表現將相對受到支撐。
同時，台灣央行原來對購地貸款須於18個月限期開工的要求，本次理監事會丈也也順勢退場，讓建商能稍微喘一口氣。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心執行長張旭嵐表示，在我國央行理監事會議前夕，美國聯準會為了對抗通膨，以一致通過的大動作升息1碼，且預計年底前還有調升空間，讓國人對央行升息充滿想像；但國內的通膨情勢比美國溫和許多，且升息對產業的衝擊較大，因此央行考量國內外的大環境差異，決議走自己的路，維持利率不變。
張旭嵐指出，在信用管制方面，由於不動產貸款集中度已有明顯下降，央行政策成效達標，加上近兩年緊縮放款已讓市場買氣顯著拉回，因此適度鬆綁管制淡化產業風險有其必要性，也讓央行給予自然人第二戶貸款更大的彈性，但其餘自然人購屋貸款均保持不變，施政維持「緊抓輕放」的原則，導引市場緩步回溫的意味濃厚；而自然人第2戶成數上修，對換屋產品的買氣也更具穩定作用。
台灣房屋集團趨勢中心資深經理陳定中表示，近年央行收緊土建融銀彈，建案開發的資金壓力大幅提高，限期開工又使業者面臨持續性的工程支出，加上近兩年銷況下滑，資金回收的速度不如預期，大型建商還能靠著豐厚家底與暫緩推案來暫度難關，但中小型建商就不容易抵抗大環境，因此央行限期開工令退場，有助於防範中小型建商資金卡關衍生的系統性風險。
paras_en: The Taiwan Central Bank held its third‑quarter board meeting today (17th), not only keeping interest rates "frozen for the 10th time" but also raising the maximum loan‑to‑value (LTV) ratio for a second home from 60% to 70%. This represents a targeted, modest tweak to selective credit controls for the housing market, and real‑estate agents say it should short‑term improve the ability of home‑switchers and pre‑sale buyers to receive their units, smoothing the flow of new‑home handovers.
At the same time, the Central Bank’s slight easing of selective credit controls is seen by agents as reducing the risk of pre‑sale contract cancellations and delayed handovers by developers.

However, Sinyi Realty (9940‑TW) notes that while the loosening of credit controls helps revive market confidence and aids home‑switchers and pre‑sale buyers, the market remains dominated by owner‑occupiers, leaving limited room for price appreciation.

Chen Jin‑ping, deputy manager of the Yongqing Realty Research Center, said the bank kept the policy rate unchanged this quarter, reflecting a cautious stance amid strong domestic growth momentum and lingering inflation concerns. She added that the concentration of real‑estate loans is falling, the share of loans for non‑owner‑occupied homes is rising, speculative activity is clearly down, and expectations of rising prices are easing, hence the modest credit tweak raising the second‑home loan cap from 60% to 70%.

Chen explained that many pre‑sale units are about to be completed; some buyers who signed contracts before the stricter rules now face being classified as second‑home borrowers at handover, requiring larger down payments and risking financing shortfalls, delayed handovers or defaults. This adjustment targets those pre‑sale and home‑switching needs, easing the actual funding pain points for consumers.

She added that raising the second‑home LTV to 70% should quickly boost the handover capacity of home‑switchers and pre‑sale buyers, making new‑home deliveries smoother and cutting the risk of contract cancellations and developer delays. For the resale market, postponed purchases due to loan limits may return, adding transaction momentum.

Overall, Chen said the higher LTV cap positively impacts confidence and transaction volume, mainly by stimulating owner‑occupied switching and pre‑sale handovers, but it should not be read as a full withdrawal of credit controls. Future transactions will still depend on banks’ lending attitudes, rates and allocation schedules, with primary purchases, switching and medium‑to‑long‑term investment remaining dominant. Transaction volume is expected to recover modestly, while price trends will stay segmented by region and product type.

Sinyi Realty noted that after the board meeting the bank kept rate conditions unchanged and sensed a cooling of speculative activity and a slowdown in price‑rise expectations. Given the continued effect of selective credit controls, raising the second‑home loan cap from 60% to 70% both supports market confidence and gives home‑switchers an extra 10% borrowing capacity, likely increasing their willingness to move.

The Central Bank introduced two relaxations: further assistance for individuals’ second‑home loans for personal or family residence, raising the maximum LTV from 60% to 70%; and the removal of the requirement that land‑purchase loans be tied to a construction start within a set period, returning the practice to standard bank credit procedures.

Zeng Jing‑de, project manager at Sinyi’s real‑estate research unit, said the 70% LTV for a second home is a market‑friendly loosening. A buyer of a NT$25 million home would now need NT$7.5 million down instead of NT$10 million, easing financing for some switchers and pre‑sale handover buyers, though overall price gains are expected to be limited as owner‑occupancy remains dominant.

Tong Li‑ting, associate manager of Sinyi’s sustainable research team, said the pre‑sale market benefits from better buyer financing and a smoother developer environment. Stable rates keep cost of funds unchanged, and the higher LTV improves cash‑flow flexibility for owner‑occupiers and switchers, supporting new project demand and conversions. Relaxing the land‑loan construction‑start rule also gives developers more flexibility in land development, timing and capital allocation, easing supply‑side pressure. Overall, the policy should boost confidence and decision‑making for both buyers and sellers, with well‑priced, well‑located projects likely to see stronger sales performance.
The Central Bank’s previous rule that land‑purchase loans must commence construction within 18 months was also dropped at the meeting, giving developers a bit of breathing room.

Zhang Xulan, CEO of the Taiwan Housing Group Trend Center, said that on the eve of the board meeting, the U.S. Federal Reserve aggressively raised rates by a full point to combat inflation, with further hikes possible before year‑end, fueling speculation about domestic rate hikes. However, Taiwan’s inflation is milder and rate hikes would hit the economy harder, so the Central Bank chose to keep rates unchanged, charting its own path.

Zhang added that because real‑estate loan concentration has clearly fallen and the bank’s policy goals have been met, coupled with a recent pull‑back in market demand from tighter lending, a moderate easing of controls helps reduce industry risk. The bank therefore gave individuals more flexibility for a second‑home loan while keeping other mortgage terms unchanged, adhering to a “tight‑but‑light” approach that should gently warm the market; the higher second‑home LTV also stabilises demand for switching properties.

Chen Ding‑zhong, senior manager at the Taiwan Housing Group Trend Center, said that recent tightening of construction‑loan financing has sharply increased funding pressure on development projects, and the mandatory construction‑start deadline adds ongoing cash‑outflows. With sales slipping over the past two years, cash recovery is slower than expected. Large developers can weather the strain with strong balance sheets and delayed launches, but small‑ and medium‑size developers are more vulnerable. Removing the construction‑deadline requirement helps prevent funding bottlenecks for these firms and reduces systemic risk.

items.title: 美銀：美公用事業費用漲幅超越整體通膨率 長期價格看升
items.title_en: BofA: US Utility Costs Rise Faster Than Overall Inflation, Long-Term Prices Expected to Increase
paras: 根據美國銀行最新報告指出，受夏季高溫、美國電網現代化及資料中心建置影響，今年夏季美國公用事業帳單漲幅已超越整體通膨率。
今年8月份平均公用事業帳單較去年同期成長5.3%，高於電力與管道瓦斯4%的漲幅，此現象緊隨美國歷史上記錄最高溫的夏季出現。截至2024年，能源帳單約占美國家戶總支出的3%。
報告分析，製造業回流、再工業化與更新老舊基礎建設的需求，正推升部分地區成本。地區間增幅差異顯著，美東東北部因電網投資帶動價格上漲，佛羅里達州則因法規調整與取消颶風復原附加費而有所調降。
今年6月至8月，底特律、巴爾的摩與華盛頓特區的能源成本年增達10%，但聖荷西、奧蘭多與坦帕等地的費用則呈下降趨勢。此外，美國能源資訊署(EIA)預估工商業用電量將成長4%，需持續投資電網，部分成本可能轉嫁給消費者。
雖然民調顯示七成美國人反對在當地興建資料中心，但美國超導公司(American Superconductor)執行長Daniel McGahn受訪時表示，資料中心與晶片廠的基建費用多屬項目建置成本，不一定會直接轉嫁至一般用戶帳單。
美國銀行補充，聖嬰現象帶來的溫和秋冬可能減少採暖需求並帶來短期緩解，但若引發南部暴風雨，則可能增加家戶維修支出。總體而言，電網升級帶來的長期費用壓力預計仍將持續。
paras_en: According to the latest report from Bank of America, due to summer heat, US grid modernization and data center construction, this summer US utility bills have risen faster than overall inflation.

In August this year, the average utility bill grew 5.3% year‑over‑year, outpacing the 4% increase in electricity and natural gas. This phenomenon follows the hottest summer on record in US history. As of 2024, energy bills account for about 3% of total household spending in the United States.

The report analyzes that reshoring manufacturing, re‑industrialization and the need to upgrade aging infrastructure are pushing up costs in some regions. The regional increase varies markedly; the Northeast of the East Coast sees price hikes driven by grid investments, while Florida sees modest declines due to regulatory adjustments and the removal of hurricane‑recovery surcharges.

From June to August this year, energy costs in Detroit, Baltimore and Washington, D.C. rose 10% year‑over‑year, whereas costs in San Jose, Orlando and Tampa showed a downward trend. In addition, the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) forecasts a 4% growth in commercial and industrial electricity consumption, requiring continued grid investment, with some costs potentially passed on to consumers.

Although polls show that 70% of Americans oppose building data centers locally, Daniel McGahn, CEO of American Superconductor, said in an interview that the infrastructure costs of data centers and chip fabs are largely project‑specific and are not necessarily passed directly to ordinary utility bills.

Bank of America added that the mild autumn and winter brought by the El Niño phenomenon may reduce heating demand and provide short‑term relief, but if it triggers storms in the South, household repair expenses could rise. Overall, the long‑term cost pressure from grid upgrades is expected to persist.

items.title: AI資料中心成美期中選舉戰場！眾院高票通過電費法案 共和黨人為何不惜與川普唱反調？
paras: 美國眾議院周三(16日)通過一項旨在保護家庭免受資料中心擴張帶來電費上漲影響的法案，是眾院首次推進直接處理資料中心產業成長所衍生經濟疑慮的立法。這顯示隨著11月期中選舉逼近，資料中心議題逐漸成為選戰熱點，部分共和黨候選人甚至不惜與力挺資料中心的總統川普出現分歧。
由共和黨掌握多數的眾院，以417票對3票通過《電費支付者保護法案》(Ratepayer Protection Act)。法案將要求州公用事業監管機構考量，包括資料中心在內的大型用電戶，是否應負擔為供應自身用電需求而興建的電力基礎設施新增成本。
共和黨眾院領袖選在眾院議員預定11月3日期中選舉前離開華盛頓之前，讓這項法案進入表決程序。即使眾院周三表決通過，目前尚不清楚該法案能否在期中選舉前獲參議院通過並成為法律。
資料中心快速擴張之際，美國政壇對此議題的看法日漸複雜。川普強力支持資料中心發展，認為這對美國維持人工智慧(AI)領域的領導地位至關重要，例如他本周稍早表示，資料中心能讓民眾及各州變得富有，並稱資料中心是「未來20、25年的石油」。
但另一方面，民主、共和兩黨議員都面臨選民對資料中心產業用電需求激增、導致電費上漲的疑慮日益升高，甚至讓兩黨近期在資料中心議題上出現難得的共識。

共和黨候選人開始與川普唱反調

俄亥俄州共和黨聯邦參議員Jon Husted就是其中一個突出的例子。他在擔任俄亥俄州副州長期間，曾歡迎資料中心進駐該州，如今他的立場已轉向強調自己支持《電費支付者保護法案》。
Husted今年7月底在參議院提出這項法案，目標是確保美國民眾不必為新資料中心所需的電力買單。他也強調支持地方決策權。
Husted上周接受電視訪問時表示，「企業有責任為當地民眾做正確的事，否則當地民眾就應該告訴他們『不』。我的立場是，這應該由當地民眾決定。」
Husted立場轉變，恰好就發生在民主黨競選對手、前聯邦參議員Sherrod Brown於7月初展開廣告攻勢後。Brown在廣告中指控Husted多年來「積極招攬資料中心」進駐俄州。
共和黨參議院競選機構全國共和黨參議院委員會(NRSC)8月中旬在一份備忘錄中警告，資料中心是「掛在Husted脖子上的錨」，並呼籲需要資料中心的企業「改變俄州民眾對它們的看法」。
Bowling Green State University西北俄亥俄州分校政治學教授Melissa Miller表示，NRSC可能「誇大了資料中心在俄州參議院選舉中的重要性」，但她補充，這項議題對選民仍很重要，因為資料中心非常醒目，即使其重要性可能不及汽油價格或其他必需品。
Miller說：「如果你的郡、社區或上班途中有一座資料中心，你就會看到它們——它們如此龐大，你不可能看不到。」
除了俄亥俄州，資料中心議題也蔓延至其他競爭激烈的參議院選戰。

從密西根到德州

川普並未放棄長期支持AI及資料中心的立場，但有時也表示，共和黨員表達反對資料中心的立場並無不妥。
川普8月中旬曾說，「如果共和黨人反對資料中心，我沒有意見。」但他同時也表示，「一般而言，如果我管理一個社區，是市長或州長，我會希望擁有資料中心，因為它們能帶來巨額收入。它們很乾淨，會自行生產能源——新建的資料中心會自行生產能源。」
在某些時候，川普的態度就沒有那麼寬容。他8月底在社群媒體發文表示，如果社區不歡迎資料中心，最終「將變得落後且貧窮」。
到了本周一，川普又表示，他認為AI及資料中心正面臨一場「病態陰謀」，而唯一對此感到高興的是中國。這番言論發表前一天，AI巨頭紛紛表示支持放慢尖端AI模型的開發速度，不過，AI巨頭並未支持放慢資料中心建設。
川普之所以捍衛資料中心，是因為AI產業已成為美國經濟及股市的重要驅動力。川普也強調，AI發展對美國與中國競爭至關重要。
儘管如此，共和黨員仍在資料中心議題上與該黨領導人出現分歧。
根據賓州大學安納伯格公共政策中心(Annenberg Public Policy Center)上月公布的民調結果，61%的美國民眾有些或強烈反對在自己所在地興建新的資料中心，高於約四個月前的49%。其中民主黨選民反對比率為69%、共和黨選民為54%、獨立選民為53%。
賓州大學政治學與傳播學教授Matt Levendusky表示，「兩黨的反應確實非常引人注目——如今你已經很難在許多議題上看到這種情況。」
Levendusky指出相關論述的關鍵：這些設施帶來的好處將由「少數企業和億萬富豪」享有，而成本則由「接納資料中心的社區」或「因AI而失去工作機會的白領」承擔。
賓州大學民調發現，美國民眾平均認為AI唯一能帶來幫助的領域是醫學研究。
在密西根州這場競爭激烈的參議院選舉中，民主黨候選人Abdul El-Sayed已對AI議題採取強硬立場。共和黨對手、前聯邦眾議員Mike Rogers隨後宣布支持暫停該州資料中心建設一年。
德州參議院選舉也出現以資料中心議題為中心的角力。德州與密州、俄州的參議院選戰，都被《庫克政治報告》(Cook Political Report)列為「五五波」(toss-up)。
共和黨候選人、德州檢察長Ken Paxton上月提出一項計畫，主張取消資料中心的租稅優惠、禁止在鄉村社區興建資料中心，並要求資料中心自行負擔所需電力成本。
民主黨候選人James Talarico則抨擊Paxton過去擔任州議員時曾投票「透過提供數十億美元的租稅優惠，讓資料中心大量進駐德州」，並表示這名共和黨候選人如今「正試圖悲哀的改弦更張」。
共和黨對資料中心的反彈可能進一步升溫，賓州大學的Levendusky表示，「如果到了2028年，所有候選人都沒有開始提出他們將如何處理AI、希望如何監管AI的計畫，我會感到非常驚訝。這將成為未來政治的一部分。」

消費者團體質疑效果

消費者權益非營利組織Public Citizen則表示，這項立法不足以充分保護美國民眾。該組織能源計畫主管Tyson Slocum說：「《電費支付者保護法案》保護消費者免受公用事業費率上漲的能力，實際上非常有限，因為它只是要求各州『考量』是否要求資料中心支付部分電網接入成本。」
他表示，聯邦政府要求各州考量採取這項措施，確實為倡議人士爭取消費者保護提供機會，但資料中心帶來的其他許多消費者及社區影響，都沒有在這項法案中獲得處理。

items.title: 聯準會升息利空出盡美股期指反彈、那斯達克100期指漲近1%
items.title_en: Fed Rate Hike Clears Bad News, US Stock Futures Rebound, Nasdaq-100 Futures Up Nearly 1%
paras: 2026年09月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ 美國聯準會升息後，市場對政策不確定性的擔憂暫時消退，美股期指週四全面反彈。截至美東時間凌晨4時45分，道瓊期指上漲0.66%，標普500期指上漲0.74%，那斯達克100期指漲幅達0.96%，科技股重新獲得資金青睞。
聯準會前一日升息1碼，重新展現抑制通膨立場，並暗示未來數月可能需要進一步緊縮。隨首次升息正式落地，市場焦點也由「是否升息」轉向後續升息速度。根據CME FedWatch，交易員預估10月再次升息的機率升至51%，高於前一日約44%。
債券市場壓力則略為緩解，美國10年期公債殖利率回落，有助降低高利率對股票估值的壓力。科技股盤前走強，Alphabet(GOOGL-US)與Meta Platforms(META-US)均上漲逾1%。
AI基礎設施相關股票反彈更為明顯。Neocloud業者CoreWeave(CRWV-US)盤前上漲6%、Nebius(NBIS-US)大漲9%，IREN(IREN-US)則上漲5%，顯示聯準會升息落地後，資金重新回流AI算力與資料中心題材。
油價則連續第2天下跌，布蘭特原油期貨下跌逾1%至每桶104.43美元，美國WTI原油期貨下跌1%至101.35美元。能源價格回落有助舒緩部分通膨疑慮，但聯準會已明確表示後續仍可能升息，因此利率路徑仍是9月下半月美股波動的主要變數。

paras_en: On September 17, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – After the Fed’s rate hike, concerns over policy uncertainty temporarily eased and US stock futures rebounded across the board on Thursday. As of 4:45 a.m. Eastern Time, the Dow futures were up 0.66%, the S&P 500 futures up 0.74%, and the Nasdaq‑100 futures rose 0.96%, with tech stocks regaining investor favor.

The Fed raised rates by one basis point the day before, reaffirming its stance to curb inflation and hinting that further tightening may be needed in the coming months. With the first hike now in effect, market focus shifted from “whether to hike” to the pace of future hikes. According to CME FedWatch, traders now see a 51% probability of another hike in October, up from about 44% the previous day.

Bond‑market pressure eased slightly as the US 10‑year Treasury yield fell, helping reduce the impact of high rates on equity valuations. Tech stocks were strong in pre‑market trading, with Alphabet (GOOGL‑US) and Meta Platforms (META‑US) both gaining more than 1%.

AI‑infrastructure stocks rallied even more sharply. CoreWeave (CRWV‑US), a Neocloud provider, jumped 6% in pre‑market trading, Nebius (NBIS‑US) surged 9%, and IREN (IREN‑US) rose 5%, indicating that after the Fed’s hike, capital is flowing back into AI compute and data‑center themes.

Oil prices fell for the second consecutive day, with Brent crude futures down over 1% to $104.43 per barrel and US WTI crude futures down 1% to $101.35. The retreat in energy prices helps ease some inflation concerns, but the Fed has made clear that further hikes remain possible, so the interest‑rate path will continue to be the main driver of US market volatility in the second half of September.
