items.title: 「AI放緩論」令科技股承壓！大摩讚SpaceX擁三大底氣：具防禦性 目標價300美元
items.title_en: "AI Slowdown" Pressures Tech Stocks! Morgan Stanley Praises SpaceX’s Three Strengths: Defensive, Target Price $300
paras: 自上周六(12日)起，先進模型要不要「主動限速」的爭論從安全圈燒到資本市場。Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei當日發布長文提出第三方評估者獲「員工級」系統訪問、統一安全標準與國際協調三步計畫，OpenAI與xAI老闆也先後表態支持，但市場擔憂訓練與算力擴張降速，周一(14日)輝達、SK海力士、美光、超微等晶片股普跌，而在這一避險情緒中，摩根士丹利Adam Jonas則在隔天出具研報重申SpaceX「增持」評級、300美元目標價，因SpaceX不是純AI故事，在模型限速衝擊下防禦屬性相對更強。
首先，Jonas認為，SpaceX收入靠星鏈而非AI資本開支。SpaceX今年第二季財報顯示，星鏈全球訂閱用戶1200萬，較去年同期600萬翻倍，單季淨增170萬；企業及政府寬頻、海事、航空等垂直客戶擴張，讓衛星通訊成為SpaceX目前最大現金牛。Jonas認為，這部分成長由滲透率、資費與衛星覆蓋驅動，不直接受「前緣模型是否放緩」影響。
其次，星艦里程碑屬工程驅動、與AI監管脫鉤。根據FAA與SpaceX最新排程，星艦第14次試飛最快將在下周一(22日)從德州Starbase升空，首次嘗試入軌。 Jonas指出，發射節奏由試飛資料而非模型訓練進度決定，對AI情緒敏感度較低。
再者，軌道AI是「長期選擇權」而非短期業績。 SpaceX已向FCC申請大規模資料中心衛星許可，並於今年揭露Starmind專案：首星AI1約150千瓦峰值算力、70公尺太陽能翼、液冷散熱，與輝達按Vera Rubin NVL72做太空優化，首批目標2027年四季度發射。Jonas認為，規模化很可能在2030年以後，但是屬於「長期限期權」。
若按大摩敏感性，每新增1GW算力、按每瓦50美元、70%增量利潤率、10倍EBITDA資本化，約增加每股27美元。
第四，資產負債表有緩衝。截至今年第二季末，SpaceX總現金約1000億美元、淨現金約610億美元。大摩預估，SpaceX可擇機發債把債務/EBITDA提至1.5—2倍，但資本開支節奏由管理層按商業計劃把控。 AI減速若壓低估值、抬高融資不確定性，充裕現金與可調式資本支出反而給SpaceX構成安全墊。
第五，估價顯示AI折價已深。根據大摩測算，SpaceX約2兆美元市值中，約四分之三來自太空與通訊，其中航太每股EPS約8美元、星鏈/連接約118美元；AI業務(企業AI加X、Grok)其模型合理值約183美元​​，但現價僅隱含約10%、即17美元左右。換言之，若市場擔心模型限速衝擊AI算力預期，SpaceX已提前「低定價」該風險。
此外，特斯拉與SpaceX的Terafab在岸上晶片專案、Optimus與Cyber​​cab協同、軌道資料中心供星上推理，構成「機器人—半導體—太空算力」的交叉選擇權。Jonas指出，市場對這類協同幾乎未定價。
Jonas的另一個理由是對馬斯克執行力的歷史觀察；2018—2019年Model 3產能地獄、2020—2021年疫情擾動中，特斯拉均透過高壓交付反轉，因此可想像SpaceX在星艦複用率與AI基礎設施早期的不確定性中推進。
整體來看，大摩並非否認AI減速對SpaceX企業AI與Starmind是逆風，而是強調「星鏈現金流+星艦工程催化+軌道AI選擇權+現金彈性」。對組合而言，若前端模型股因限速預期重估算力需求，SpaceX更像一個帶有航太基本盤、AI上行不對稱的防禦型替代品。不過，一旦星艦15、Starmind首批在軌、Terafab量產與AI客戶承諾任何一項延後，300美元目標價的兌現週期都會被拉長。
paras_en: Since last Saturday (the 12th), the debate over whether advanced models should be "actively throttled" has spread from the safety community to capital markets. Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei posted a long article that day outlining a three‑step plan for third‑party evaluators to get "employee‑level" system access, unified safety standards, and international coordination. The heads of OpenAI and xAI also voiced support, but the market worries that training and compute expansion will slow. On Monday (the 14th) chip stocks such as Nvidia, SK Hynix, Micron and AMD fell sharply. Amid this risk‑off sentiment, Morgan Stanley’s Adam Jonas issued a research note the next day reaffirming a "Buy" rating on SpaceX with a $300 target price, arguing that SpaceX is not a pure AI story and its defensive attributes are relatively stronger under model‑throttling pressure.

Jonas argues that SpaceX’s revenue comes from Starlink rather than AI capital spending. SpaceX’s Q2 report shows 12 million global Starlink subscribers, double the 6 million a year earlier, with a net quarterly gain of 1.7 million. Expansion among enterprise, government broadband, maritime and aviation verticals makes satellite communications SpaceX’s biggest cash cow. Jonas says this growth is driven by penetration rate, pricing and satellite coverage and is not directly affected by whether “front‑end models slow down.”

Second, Starship milestones are engineering‑driven and decoupled from AI regulation. According to the FAA and SpaceX’s latest schedule, the 14th Starship test flight could launch from Texas’s Starbase as early as next Monday (the 22nd) for its first orbital attempt. Jonas notes that launch cadence is set by test‑flight data, not model‑training progress, making it less sensitive to AI sentiment.

Third, orbital AI is a "long‑term option" rather than short‑term earnings. SpaceX has applied to the FCC for a large‑scale data‑center satellite license and unveiled the Starmind project this year: the first Star AI‑1 will have about 150 kW peak compute, a 70‑meter solar wing, liquid‑cooling, and will be space‑optimized with Nvidia’s Vera Rubin NVL72. The first batch is slated for launch in Q4 2027. Jonas believes scaling is likely only after 2030, making it a "long‑dated option."
Using Morgan Stanley’s sensitivity assumptions—each additional 1 GW of compute valued at $50 per watt, a 70 % incremental profit margin and a 10‑times EBITDA multiple—adds roughly $27 per share.

Fourth, the balance sheet provides a cushion. By the end of Q2 this year, SpaceX held about $100 billion in total cash and roughly $61 billion in net cash. Morgan Stanley estimates SpaceX could opportunistically issue debt to raise its debt/EBITDA ratio to 1.5‑2×, while capital‑expenditure pacing remains under management’s commercial plan. If AI slowdown depresses valuation and raises financing uncertainty, abundant cash and flexible capex become a safety net for SpaceX.

Fifth, valuation shows the AI discount is already deep. Morgan Stanley calculates that of SpaceX’s roughly $2 trillion market value, about three‑quarters comes from space and communications, with aerospace contributing about $8 per share EPS and Starlink/Connectivity about $118. The AI business (enterprise AI plus X, Grok) has a reasonable model value of about $183, but the current price implies only about a 10 % discount—roughly $17. In other words, if the market fears model throttling will hit AI compute expectations, SpaceX has already priced that risk at a low valuation.

Moreover, Tesla and SpaceX’s Terafab on‑shore chip projects, the Optimus‑Cyber‑cab collaboration, and orbital data‑center inference for satellite‑based AI create a cross‑option of "robotics‑semiconductors‑space compute." Jonas points out that the market has barely priced in these synergies.

Jonas also cites his historical view of Elon Musk’s execution ability; after the Model 3 production hell of 2018‑19 and the pandemic disruptions of 2020‑21, Tesla repeatedly turned the tide through high‑pressure deliveries, suggesting SpaceX can push forward despite early uncertainties in Starship reuse rates and AI infrastructure.

Overall, Morgan Stanley does not deny that an AI slowdown is a headwind for SpaceX’s enterprise AI and Starmind, but it emphasizes "Starlink cash flow + Starship engineering catalyst + orbital AI option + cash flexibility." For portfolios, if front‑end model stocks are re‑rated lower on compute‑demand expectations, SpaceX looks like a defensive alternative with an aerospace base and asymmetric AI upside. However, any delay in Starship 15, the first Starmind satellites, Terafab mass production or AI customer commitments would extend the timeline for achieving the $300 target price.

items.title: 挖掘困境中的投資契機 頂尖經理人靠「CIA策略」打造高績效價值基金
items.title_en: Finding Investment Opportunities in Distress: Top Manager Uses "CIA Strategy" to Build High-Performance Value Fund
paras: 知名資產管理機構 T. Rowe Price 的基金經理人塞Sebastien Mallet所管理的環球價值股票基金(T. Rowe Price Global Value Equity Fund)，自 2012 年成立以來即獲得晨星(Morningstar)五星頂級評等。Mallet透露，其全球價值投資能脫穎而出的關鍵之一，正是「專挑遭遇麻煩的公司」。

核心策略：「CIA 框架」與不對稱風險報酬

Mallet管理的這檔基金規模達 3.131 億美元，精選 80 至 100 家企業進行配置。他的投資決策完全圍繞著「CIA 框架」——即爭議(Controversy)、洞見(Insight)以及不對稱風險報酬(Asymmetric risk-reward)。
Mallet接受《MarketWatch》訪問時強調，當某檔股票面臨困境，而團隊分析師能判斷該問題僅為暫時性時，這就形成了關鍵的「洞見」。在評估不對稱風險報酬時，他會分別建立看多與看空情境模型，精算若看錯會虧損多少、看對又能獲利多少。
這套策略讓該基金過去一年、三年及五年期績效均超越 MSCI 世界指數基準，過去 12 個月更大幅上漲 38%，逼近其歷史最佳單年表現。

掌握 AI 轉折點與半導體布局

在科技股操作上，Mallet展現了極佳的時間點掌控能力。約1年前，其科技分析團隊預測大型語言模型將轉向記憶體密集型運算，使他提早布局記憶體類股，並在夏季回檔前成功出脫 Sandisk 與日本 Kioxia 等標的獲利了結。
談及下一波 AI 浪潮，Mallet引述分析師觀點表示，未來世界將朝向「AI 代理人對自主代理人對話」(agents talking to agents)發展，需要的運算能力將是目前的數倍。Mallet說明：「這就是為什麼我們仍然持有 Intel 和 AMD，我們確信未來市場將需要更多 CPU 和強大晶片。」

貨幣貶值交易與防禦性產業配置

除了科技股外，貴金屬與金融股也是帶動績效的主要引擎。Mallet指出，自新冠疫情以來，政府持續擴大財政赤字與印鈔，促使投資人轉向黃金或比特幣，形成「貨幣貶值交易」。他強調，黃金是「終極購買力保護者」，價格已從疫情前的每盎司約 1,500 美元攀升至 4,000 美元以上。
目前基金有約 8% 的資金配置於 Franco-Nevada 與 Wheaton Precious Metals 等黃金權利金公司，且今年持續加碼。
在金融領域，金融股為該基金最大產業，核心持股摩根大通自基金成立第一天持有一直至今。Mallet讚賞摩根大通經營極佳，在高利率環境下表現卓越，且股東權益報酬率(ROE)達 20%。
此外，他也布局醫療保健類股(如 Gilead Sciences 與 AstraZeneca)作為熊市中的防禦性配置，並認為這一產業目前價格被嚴重低估。
paras_en: Renowned asset manager T. Rowe Price’s fund manager Sebastien Mallet oversees the T. Rowe Price Global Value Equity Fund, which has earned a Morningstar five‑star rating since its launch in 2012. Mallet says a key to the fund’s global value edge is “selecting companies that are in trouble.”

Core strategy: the “CIA framework” and asymmetric risk‑reward. Mallet’s fund, with assets of $313.1 million, picks 80‑100 companies for its portfolio. His investment decisions revolve around the CIA framework—Controversy, Insight, and Asymmetric risk‑reward.

In a MarketWatch interview, Mallet stressed that when a stock faces difficulty and his team judges the problem to be temporary, that creates a crucial “insight.” When assessing asymmetric risk‑reward, he builds separate bullish and bearish scenario models to calculate potential loss if he’s wrong and potential gain if he’s right.
The strategy has helped the fund beat the MSCI World Index over one‑, three‑ and five‑year periods, and it jumped 38% over the past 12 months, approaching its best single‑year performance ever.

Capturing the AI inflection point and semiconductor positioning. About a year ago, his tech team forecast that large language models would shift toward memory‑intensive computing, prompting an early tilt toward memory stocks and a profitable exit from Sandisk and Japan’s Kioxia before the summer pullback.

Discussing the next AI wave, Mallet cited analysts who say the future will involve “agents talking to agents,” requiring several times today’s compute power. He explained, “That’s why we still hold Intel and AMD—we believe the market will need more CPUs and powerful chips.”

Currency‑devaluation trades and defensive sector allocation. Beyond tech, precious metals and financial stocks have been major performance drivers. Mallet notes that since the pandemic governments have expanded deficits and printed money, pushing investors toward gold or Bitcoin in a “currency‑devaluation trade.” He stresses gold is the “ultimate purchasing‑power protector,” with prices rising from about $1,500 per ounce pre‑pandemic to over $4,000 today.
The fund currently allocates roughly 8% of its assets to gold royalty companies such as Franco‑Nevada and Wheaton Precious Metals, and has continued to add to those positions this year.

In the financial sector, banking stocks are the fund’s largest industry exposure, with JPMorgan Chase held since day one. Mallet praises JPMorgan’s excellent management, strong performance in a high‑rate environment, and a 20% return on equity.
He also has exposure to healthcare stocks like Gilead Sciences and AstraZeneca as defensive holdings in a bear market, believing the sector is currently severely undervalued.

items.title: 英特爾喊話打破台積電壟斷！陳立武：AI晶片不能95%押一家台灣公司
paras: 英特爾(INTC-US) 執行長陳立武表示，產業界必須打破台積電對全球晶圓代工市場的壟斷，並主張應將訂單分散至多家供應商，以因應人工智慧晶片日益高漲的需求。
英特爾正將其未來押注於晶圓代工業務的復甦。陳立武亦指出，中央處理器需求的暴增將使市場供給持續吃緊。
陳立武在美國科羅拉多州丹佛舉行、由 Splunk 主辦的 .conf26 大會主題演講中發表上述看法。他表示，能同時掌握晶片製造、設計以及先進封裝能力，是半導體產業的關鍵。
「這就是我們投入其中的原因。」陳立武表示，英特爾是美國乃至全球科技產業的重要企業。
晶圓代工難度高 英特爾押注先進封裝
陳立武指出，經營晶圓廠是一項極具挑戰的業務，因為需要掌握最先進的製程技術。他表示，良率、缺陷、製程週期時間以及生產變異等每一項因素，都必須嚴格管理，才能讓產出具備可預測性。
「如你所知，每個客戶都有不同需求。」陳立武表示，晶圓代工廠必須擁有完整的智慧財產權（IP），並支援電子設計自動化（EDA）工具，而其中最重要的關鍵是先進封裝技術。
他指出，將 CPU、記憶體、輸入輸出元件以及不同晶片整合在單一封裝中並不容易，需要大量技術累積。
陳立武也明確表示，希望打破台積電在全球 AI 晶片製造市場的主導地位。
他認為，所有事情都越來越朝向系統化方法與封裝發展，這就是未來。「你不應該有 95% 的依賴集中在一家位於台灣的公司，我認為這是一個非常重要的問題。」

台積電市占逾七成 代工霸主地位難撼動

根據研究機構 Counterpoint 數據，台積電(2330-TW) 今年第一季占全球晶圓代工營收比重超過 70%，大幅領先三星電子(005930KS) 、中芯國際(00981-HK) 以及英特爾(INTC-US) 。
陳立武表示，晶圓代工業務並不容易，需要謹慎布局，也需要投入大量資本支出。「好消息是，過去 18 個月情況已經有所改善。」
英特爾過去在 14A 製程（相當於 1.4 奈米級製程）面臨良率問題，但今年4月已同意為由特斯拉(TSLA-US) 與 SpaceX(SPCX-US) 主導的 Terafab 計畫提供 14A 製程技術。Terafab 首款產品預計於 2028 年年中推出。
今年6月，英特爾延攬前 SK 海力士執行長李錫熙（Lee Seok-hee）擔任執行副總裁，負責晶圓代工部門的先進封裝、後段技術開發與製造。面對製程良率挑戰，英特爾引入具記憶體與封裝經驗的高階主管，以強化後段製造能力。
業界也推測，SK海力士(000660KS)(SKHY-US) 與英特爾未來可能在高頻寬記憶體（HBM）領域合作，由英特爾負責生產 HBM 所需的基礎邏輯晶片（base die）。

EMIB挑戰台積電CoWoS CPU需求仍供不應求

陳立武同時對英特爾的先進封裝技術EMIB（嵌入式多晶片互連橋接）展現信心。
EMIB透過矽橋連接晶片，讓多顆晶片能如同一體般運作。相較之下，台積電採用 CoWoS封裝技術，透過在基板上放置中介層，再將晶片堆疊其上。
英特爾正將 EMIB 視為與 CoWoS 競爭的重要技術。「最大的挑戰之一在於基板，」陳立武指出，日本與台灣企業掌控了相關供應，且要求必須預付訂單款項才能確保料源。
此外，陳立武也強調英特爾核心產品 CPU 的需求強勁，並預期隨著 AI 智慧體（AI agents）數量快速增加，當前供應短缺將持續。
他指出，圖形處理器（GPU）主要用於 AI 模型訓練，但 CPU 在推論階段扮演重要角色，負責協調大量 GPU 運作並管理應用程式，是 AI 推論時代的重要晶片。
「CPU的需求如此孔急，以至於我們只能滿足50%的客戶，」陳立武坦言，「許多企業執行長打電話給我，而我只能向他們致歉，表示我們產能不足。」
他並補充，未來將有數以百萬、甚至數兆計的 AI 智慧體運行，需要更多運算資源。「我們需要足夠的運算能力與安全性，才能因應這股需求。」

items.title: 川普顧問納瓦羅痛批聯準會主席華許：升息是「愚蠢決策」
items.title_en: Trump Adviser Navarro Criticizes Fed Chair Warsh: Rate Hike is a "Foolish Decision"
paras: 美國聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)周三(16日)宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，將基準利率上調至 3.75% 至 4.00% 區間，以壓低仍高於 2% 目標的通膨。此舉引發白宮貿易與製造業顧問納瓦羅(Peter Navarro)的強烈反彈。
納瓦羅公開痛批這是一項「愚蠢的決定」，更是「直刺實體經濟心臟的短劍」。
納瓦羅強調，當前因伊朗衝突導致油價與柴油價格飆升，美國正面臨嚴重的能源價格衝擊。高油價本身已迫使民眾增加燃料支出、削減其他消費，產生抑制經濟成長的效果。在此情勢下聯準會仍堅持升息，無異於對美國經濟進行「二次打擊」。
他舉前聯準會主席格林斯潘(Alan Greenspan)與伯南克(Ben Bernanke)為例，指兩人在1990年代初伊拉克入侵科威特及2006至2007年伊朗衝突導致油價大漲時，均未升息。納瓦羅質疑聯準會過度優先考慮壓低通膨，卻忽視了就業與民眾生活負擔。
納瓦羅在《NewsNation》電視專訪及在社群平台 X 轉發影片發動攻勢。他使用「愚蠢且糟糕的政策」等嚴詞，並爆料華許曾向他承諾不會升息。
納瓦羅表示，華許並非合適的主席人選，甚至質疑聯準會若在選舉前夕升息是出於政治動機，意圖「透過傷害美國來傷害川普」。
對此，川普總統雖稱讚華許是個好人、但正面對一個「具敵意的理事會」，同時還在社交平台上，要求聯準會應迅速將利率降至 1% 或更低。
paras_en: On Wednesday (16th), Federal Reserve Chair Kevin Warsh announced a 25 basis point rate hike, raising the benchmark rate to a 3.75%–4.00% range to curb inflation still above the 2% target, prompting a sharp backlash from White House trade and manufacturing adviser Peter Navarro.
Navarro publicly slammed the move as a "foolish decision" and a "short sword that directly strikes the heart of the real economy."

Navarro emphasized that the current spike in oil and diesel prices, driven by the Iran conflict, is causing a severe energy price shock in the United States. High oil prices have already forced consumers to increase fuel spending and cut other consumption, dampening economic growth; in this context, the Fed’s insistence on raising rates amounts to a "second blow" to the U.S. economy.

He cited former Fed chairs Alan Greenspan and Ben Bernanke, noting that neither raised rates during the early 1990s Iraq invasion of Kuwait nor during the 2006–2007 Iran conflict that spiked oil prices. Navarro questioned the Fed’s overemphasis on inflation at the expense of employment and the burden on citizens.

Navarro launched the attack in a NewsNation TV interview and on the social media platform X, using harsh language such as "foolish and terrible policy" and alleging that Warsh had promised him not to raise rates.
Navarro stated that Warsh is not a suitable chair and even questioned whether the Fed’s pre‑election rate hike is politically motivated, aimed at "hurting the United States to hurt Trump."
In response, President Trump praised Warsh as a good person but faced a "hostile board," and on social media urged the Fed to quickly cut rates to 1% or lower.

items.title: 抗升息利空！光通訊股Lumentum、Coherent逆勢大漲 資金押注AI實體訂單
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)周三(16日)升息讓美股走勢低迷，但光通訊巨頭卻逆勢成為標普500領漲股，Lumentum(LITE-US)與Coherent(COHR-US)分別收高9.6%與6.9%，代表投資人仍看好人工智慧(AI)硬體產業中那些已有確實需求的領域。
Direxion資本市場主管Jake Behan說：「交易員正將資金押注在供應鏈中需求確實存在的部分，他們偏好支出已經確定的領域。」

光通訊成AI資料中心領域重要受惠者

PurePlay ETFs執行長Joseph DeYonker表示，AI資料中心供應鏈中較下游的硬體製造商，是觀察AI基礎建設潛在需求的良好指標，這些公司「正是AI系統實際部署轉化為網路設備、伺服器及其他實體基礎建設需求的地方」。
DeYonker認為，AI交易的投資人正變得更加挑剔，尋找生態系統中實際看到訂單與產能擴充的部分。他說：「光學連接是一個值得關注的領域，因為隨著AI叢集規模擴大，GPU之間以及資料中心之間傳輸的資料量持續增加。」
這意味著Lumentum在內的光學供應商，將在資料中心擴建的過程中扮演更吃重的角色。不過DeYonker也說，隨著市場預期升高，光通訊類股可能面臨更大的波動。

AI支出仍看增 資料中心建置恐延遲

考量到AI硬體股周一曾因Anthropic等業界大咖呼籲放慢發展腳步而大跌一波，也有分析師指出，周三的漲勢可能是大跌後的反彈。
Freedom Capital Markets科技研究主管Paul Meeks就是其一，他雖然預期AI基建支出將持續，但也補充指出，考量到資料中心擴建成為今年美國期中選舉選民關注的議題，相關類股未來幾個月可能出現震盪交易。
Meeks表示：「資料中心是規模非常龐大且高度複雜的商業不動產項目，就像任何數十億美元規模的計畫一樣，不可避免會出現延遲。」
不過，更多資料中心基礎建設供應預定明年起陸續上線，並持續至更後期，這預料將成為AI交易的重要推動力。

美光財報成需求風向球 訂單尚未完全滿足

Direxion的Behan表示，預定本月底公布的美光(MU-US)財報，將為市場「非常單純的反映基礎建設需求」。
他指出，美光目前收到的資料中心需求中，完成供應的比率不到一半，「如果他們能在財測中維持這樣的未完成需求(backlog，指已確認但尚未交或的訂單總量)，那將是對任何AI支出放緩說法強而有力的反駁。」
PurePlay的DeYonker提醒，由於Fed周三升息1碼並暗示還會再升，當利率上揚，可能對快速成長科技股的估值造成壓力，儘管如此，支持下一代AI所需的實體基礎建設，仍有相當大量尚待興建」。

items.title: 英國央行不再向市場拋售長債！4880億英鎊QT計畫全面改寫
items.title_en: Bank of England Stops Selling Long‑Term Bonds, Rewrites £488 bn QT Plan
paras: 英國央行(BoE)周四(17日)宣布全面改寫量化緊縮(QT)計畫，將暫停所有英國公債出售至明年4月，並停止向市場拋售超長天期公債，目標在2034年前處理規模達4,880億英鎊(約6,500億美元)的債券投資組合。新制可望減少央行與政府發債爭奪市場需求，消息帶動長天期英債上漲、殖利率下滑。
這項調整與英國央行維持基準利率在3.75%的決定同時公布。央行一方面警告中東戰事造成的通膨壓力可能迫使其升息，另一方面則藉由放慢QT，緩解英國公債市場近期面臨的供給壓力。

4,880億英鎊債券分三路處理

根據尚待敲定的方案，英國央行持有的4,880億英鎊公債將分為三部分處理。其中，1,200億英鎊、於2049年或之後到期的超長天期公債，將永久保留在資產負債表，作為流通鈔票的資產擔保。
另有2,220億英鎊公債將於2034年底前陸續到期，央行不再將到期資金重新投入市場；其餘1,460億英鎊、於2035年至2049年間到期的公債，則預計以每年200億英鎊的速度出售。
英國央行正與財政部研議，不再透過市場標售，而是按市價直接將部分債券出售給英國債務管理局(DMO)，再由後者註銷債券並依市場需求調整政府發債規模。最終安排仍須獲得財政部同意，預計在明年4月前確定。
新制實施後，包括公債自然到期及主動出售在內，英國央行每年平均縮減規模約為460億英鎊，低於過去12個月的700億英鎊。央行貨幣政策委員會(MPC)以9票對0票一致通過新方案。

售債累虧1100億英鎊 長債殖利率應聲下滑

英國央行在2009年至2021年間透過量化寬鬆(QE)買進8,950億英鎊債券，藉此刺激經濟並壓低長期利率，2022年起停止將到期資金再投資，並開始直接向市場出售公債。
不過，央行在利率上升後出售低收益債券，迄今已產生約1,100億英鎊損失，最終由納稅人承擔；英國央行文件原先預估，未來可能再出現約1,000億英鎊損失。自由民主黨、英國改革黨及綠黨均曾呼籲終止QT，或對因高利率獲利的銀行徵收暴利稅，以降低公共財政負擔。
英國央行總裁貝里(Andrew Bailey)表示，新安排可維持貨幣政策獨立性，並透過降低整體成本與風險，提高計畫長期效益。央行認為，QT約使英債殖利率上升25個基點，但部分分析師估計，對30年期殖利率的推升幅度可能接近75個基點。
消息公布後，英國30年期公債殖利率下跌約5個基點至5.80%。由於央行暫停售債，不再於短期內與政府發債競爭買盤，市場供給壓力可望獲得喘息。
paras_en: The Bank of England (BoE) announced on Thursday (17th) that it will completely rewrite its quantitative tightening (QT) programme, suspending all UK government bond sales until April next year and stopping the sale of ultra‑long‑term bonds. The aim is to manage a £488 bn (about US$650 bn) bond portfolio by 2034. The new regime is expected to reduce competition between the BoE and the Treasury for market demand, pushing long‑term UK bond prices higher and yields lower.

This adjustment was announced alongside the BoE’s decision to keep the base rate at 3.75%. The bank warned that inflationary pressure from Middle‑East conflicts could force further rate hikes, while a slower QT would ease the supply pressure currently facing the UK bond market.

The £488 bn of bonds will be handled in three ways. One part, £120 bn of ultra‑long bonds maturing in 2049 or later, will remain permanently on the balance sheet as collateral for circulating currency.

Another £222 bn of bonds will mature by the end of 2034, and the BoE will no longer reinvest the proceeds into the market. The remaining £146 bn of bonds maturing between 2035 and 2049 will be sold at a pace of £20 bn per year.

The BoE is negotiating with the Treasury to sell bonds directly to the UK Debt Management Office (DMO) at market price, after which the DMO will cancel the bonds and adjust the Treasury’s issuance to meet demand. Final approval from the Treasury is required, expected by April next year.

Under the new regime, the BoE will reduce its balance sheet by an average of £46 bn per year, including natural maturities and active sales, a drop from the £70 bn cut over the past 12 months. The Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) approved the plan unanimously, 9‑0.

Between 2009 and 2021, the BoE bought £895 bn of bonds under quantitative easing (QE) to stimulate the economy and lower long‑term rates. Since 2022 it has stopped reinvesting maturing funds and has begun selling bonds directly to the market.

However, selling low‑yield bonds after rate hikes has already incurred about £110 bn of losses, ultimately borne by taxpayers. BoE documents originally estimated that another £100 bn of losses could arise. The Liberal Democrats, Reform UK, and the Green Party have called for ending QT or imposing a windfall tax on banks profiting from high rates to ease public finances.

BoE Governor Andrew Bailey said the new arrangement preserves monetary policy independence and, by reducing overall costs and risks, improves the long‑term benefits of the programme. The BoE estimates that QT raises UK bond yields by about 25 basis points, though some analysts predict the lift on 30‑year yields could approach 75 basis points.

After the announcement, the 30‑year UK bond yield fell roughly 5 basis points to 5.80%. With the BoE temporarily halting bond sales and no longer competing with the Treasury for short‑term demand, supply pressure in the market is expected to ease.

items.title: 美銀：美公用事業費用漲幅超越整體通膨率 長期價格看升
items.title_en: BofA: US Utility Costs Rise Faster Than Overall Inflation, Long-Term Prices Expected to Increase
paras: 根據美國銀行最新報告指出，受夏季高溫、美國電網現代化及資料中心建置影響，今年夏季美國公用事業帳單漲幅已超越整體通膨率。
今年8月份平均公用事業帳單較去年同期成長5.3%，高於電力與管道瓦斯4%的漲幅，此現象緊隨美國歷史上記錄最高溫的夏季出現。截至2024年，能源帳單約占美國家戶總支出的3%。
報告分析，製造業回流、再工業化與更新老舊基礎建設的需求，正推升部分地區成本。地區間增幅差異顯著，美東東北部因電網投資帶動價格上漲，佛羅里達州則因法規調整與取消颶風復原附加費而有所調降。
今年6月至8月，底特律、巴爾的摩與華盛頓特區的能源成本年增達10%，但聖荷西、奧蘭多與坦帕等地的費用則呈下降趨勢。此外，美國能源資訊署(EIA)預估工商業用電量將成長4%，需持續投資電網，部分成本可能轉嫁給消費者。
雖然民調顯示七成美國人反對在當地興建資料中心，但美國超導公司(American Superconductor)執行長Daniel McGahn受訪時表示，資料中心與晶片廠的基建費用多屬項目建置成本，不一定會直接轉嫁至一般用戶帳單。
美國銀行補充，聖嬰現象帶來的溫和秋冬可能減少採暖需求並帶來短期緩解，但若引發南部暴風雨，則可能增加家戶維修支出。總體而言，電網升級帶來的長期費用壓力預計仍將持續。
paras_en: According to the latest report from Bank of America, due to summer heat, US grid modernization and data center construction, this summer US utility bills have risen faster than overall inflation.

In August this year, the average utility bill grew 5.3% year‑over‑year, outpacing the 4% increase in electricity and natural gas. This phenomenon follows the hottest summer on record in US history. As of 2024, energy bills account for about 3% of total household spending in the United States.

The report analyzes that reshoring manufacturing, re‑industrialization and the need to upgrade aging infrastructure are pushing up costs in some regions. The regional increase varies markedly; the Northeast of the East Coast sees price hikes driven by grid investments, while Florida sees modest declines due to regulatory adjustments and the removal of hurricane‑recovery surcharges.

From June to August this year, energy costs in Detroit, Baltimore and Washington, D.C. rose 10% year‑over‑year, whereas costs in San Jose, Orlando and Tampa showed a downward trend. In addition, the U.S. Energy Information Administration (EIA) forecasts a 4% growth in commercial and industrial electricity consumption, requiring continued grid investment, with some costs potentially passed on to consumers.

Although polls show that 70% of Americans oppose building data centers locally, Daniel McGahn, CEO of American Superconductor, said in an interview that the infrastructure costs of data centers and chip fabs are largely project‑specific and are not necessarily passed directly to ordinary utility bills.

Bank of America added that the mild autumn and winter brought by the El Niño phenomenon may reduce heating demand and provide short‑term relief, but if it triggers storms in the South, household repair expenses could rise. Overall, the long‑term cost pressure from grid upgrades is expected to persist.

items.title: 英國央行不跟Fed升息！貝里警告：中東戰火恐逼央行出手
paras: 英國央行(BoE)周四(17日)以6比3票決議維持基準利率在3.75%不變，未跟進聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行(ECB)升息，但對通膨前景的措辭明顯轉趨鷹派，並警告中東戰事若持續推高能源價格，可能迫使央行收緊貨幣政策。
英國央行總裁貝里(Andrew Bailey)表示，全球能源成本上升目前對英國物價與薪資設定的影響仍有限，但市場波動持續愈久，對通膨造成的衝擊就愈大，央行也愈可能需要升息，以確保通膨回落至2%目標。

通膨恐突破4% 政策措辭明顯轉鷹

英國央行表示，自7月發布上一份經濟預測以來，通膨風險進一步偏向上行，近期能源價格走勢已接近央行先前設定的「不利情境」，可能使通膨壓力根深蒂固。
英國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率升至3.1%，為3月以來首度突破3%，主要受到汽油價格年增23%推動。央行目前預估，英國通膨率可能在2027年初略高於4%，相當於官方目標的兩倍，遠高於先前預測的2026年底3.2%高峰。
儘管勞動市場與企業定價尚未顯示持續性物價壓力，但央行認為相關風險正在升高。由於第二輪通膨效應通常延後出現，不能等到明確跡象浮現後才採取行動。
值得注意的是，不只3名主張立即升息的官員態度鷹派，貝里與3名副總裁布里登(Sarah Breeden)、隆巴德利(Clare Lombardelli)及拉姆斯登(Dave Ramsden)，也都在會議紀錄中提到未來提高利率的可能性，顯示貨幣政策委員會(MPC)內部對升息的接受度正在擴大。

三名官員主張預先升息防堵風險

MPC以6票贊成維持利率、3票支持升息1碼至4%，投票結果與7月會議相同。支持升息的官員包括首席經濟學家皮爾(Huw Pill)，以及外部委員葛林(Megan Greene)和曼恩(Catherine Mann)。
曼恩指出，中東戰事反覆延續，已使能源價格升至遠高於7月基準預測的水準。在通膨走勢與第二輪效應充滿不確定性之際，預先升息是較好的風險管理策略，可避免通膨根深蒂固後，被迫採取更緊縮的政策。
葛林則將伊朗戰爭的間接影響、人工智慧(AI)相關供給限制及聖嬰現象列為潛在通膨來源。皮爾表示，升息可在地緣政治衝突與經濟數據雜訊中，明確展現央行維護物價穩定的決心。
不過，施羅德全球經濟主管里斯(David Rees)認為，英國本土通膨仍受控制、薪資成長正在減速，失業率接近5%，顯示勞動市場已有明顯閒置空間，目前經濟並未迫切需要更高利率，財政政策反而是更大的風險。
英國央行同時將第三季經濟成長率預測由0.1%上調至0.4%，但升息警告仍可能對試圖在10月28日預算案公布前提振經濟信心的英國政府形成壓力。

全面暫停售債 重新規畫量化緊縮

英國央行也大幅調整縮減公債投資組合的方式。過去央行會在每年9月公布未來一年的減持規模，如今改為設定長期目標，計畫在2034年前將基於貨幣政策目的持有的英國公債降至零，但仍會保留部分用於支應鈔票發行的超長天期公債。
央行將暫停所有主動售債，2035年前到期的公債原則上會持有至到期，不再直接出售給市場；至於2035年至2049年到期的債券，央行將評估是否出售給英國政府，並預計在明年4月前公布後續安排。
利率決策公布後，交易員降低升息押注，但市場仍完全反映年底前升息1次的可能性，並認為再升1次的機率約為50%。英國公債價格走高，10年期公債殖利率下跌約4個基點至5.2473%，30年期殖利率下滑約7個基點至5.7932%。
這項決定也凸顯英國央行與其他主要央行暫時分道揚鑣。Fed周三完成2023年以來首次升息，歐洲央行上周則進行今年第二次升息，日本央行也被市場預期可能在周五採取行動。

items.title: 日經：日美關稅協議納入在美設晶片廠 擬斥資3兆日元由格羅方德營運
items.title_en: Nikkei: Japan‑US tariff pact to include a U.S. chip plant, proposes up to ¥3 trillion to be operated by GlobalFoundries
paras: 據日媒報導，日美兩國政府官員正密切洽談合作在美國興建一座大型半導體工廠。此計畫預計納入兩國關稅協議下、總額達 5,500 億美元的對美投資承諾中，作為第三批重點推動項目。
此建廠計畫預估總投資金額介於 2 兆至 3 兆日元(約 128 億至 193 億美元)，將由美國晶圓代工大廠格羅方德(GlobalFoundries)負責營運，主要生產用於運算與處理工作的邏輯晶片。
《日經亞洲》報導指出，日美雙方已於日前舉行工作層級會談，方針包含評估投資回收前景等關鍵細節。過去日美推動的對美投資多集中於電力與能源基礎建設，若此晶片廠順利獲批，將代表著兩國產業合作首度延伸至高科技與製造業。
針對營運夥伴的選擇，市場研究機構 TrendForce資料顯示，格羅方德目前在全球晶圓代工市占率排名第五，營運重點在於成熟製程與特殊製程，廣泛供應汽車、航太及國防等產業所需晶片。華府將格羅方德視為推動半導體本土化與保障經濟安全的重要戰略企業。
針對戰略佈局與潛在風險，市場分析師指出，日美聯合推動新晶片廠反映了雙方降低對單一亞洲生產基地依賴、推動供應鏈多元化的共同目標，並切合美方擴大本土製造的政策方向。
然而，觀察家與分析師也提醒，高昂的營運成本、技術人才缺口以及投資報酬率，仍是項目能否最終落地的關鍵變數，日本國內對大規模對外投資帶來的財政負擔也備受討論。
paras_en: According to Japanese media reports, officials from the Japanese and U.S. governments are in close talks to cooperate on building a large semiconductor fab in the United States. The project is expected to be incorporated into the $550 billion U.S. investment commitment under the two‑country tariff agreement, as the third priority initiative.

The plant is estimated to require a total investment of between ¥2 trillion and ¥3 trillion (about $12.8 billion to $19.3 billion) and will be operated by U.S. foundry giant GlobalFoundries, focusing on logic chips for computing and processing workloads.

Nikkei Asia reported that Japan and the United States recently held a working‑level meeting, covering key details such as the outlook for investment recovery. Historically, Japan‑U.S. outbound investment has been concentrated on power and energy infrastructure; approval of this chip fab would mark the first extension of bilateral industrial cooperation into high‑tech manufacturing.

Regarding the operating partner, market research firm TrendForce shows that GlobalFoundries currently ranks fifth worldwide in foundry market share, with a focus on mature and specialty process nodes that serve automotive, aerospace and defense sectors. Washington regards GlobalFoundries as a strategic company for domesticising semiconductors and safeguarding economic security.

Analysts note that the joint push for a new chip fab reflects a shared goal of reducing reliance on a single Asian production base and diversifying supply chains, aligning with U.S. policy to expand domestic manufacturing.

However, observers and analysts caution that high operating costs, a shortage of technical talent, and the investment’s return‑on‑investment remain critical variables for the project’s eventual execution, and Japan’s fiscal burden from large‑scale overseas investment is also under debate.

items.title: AI資料中心成美期中選舉戰場！眾院高票通過電費法案 共和黨人為何不惜與川普唱反調？
paras: 美國眾議院周三(16日)通過一項旨在保護家庭免受資料中心擴張帶來電費上漲影響的法案，是眾院首次推進直接處理資料中心產業成長所衍生經濟疑慮的立法。這顯示隨著11月期中選舉逼近，資料中心議題逐漸成為選戰熱點，部分共和黨候選人甚至不惜與力挺資料中心的總統川普出現分歧。
由共和黨掌握多數的眾院，以417票對3票通過《電費支付者保護法案》(Ratepayer Protection Act)。法案將要求州公用事業監管機構考量，包括資料中心在內的大型用電戶，是否應負擔為供應自身用電需求而興建的電力基礎設施新增成本。
共和黨眾院領袖選在眾院議員預定11月3日期中選舉前離開華盛頓之前，讓這項法案進入表決程序。即使眾院周三表決通過，目前尚不清楚該法案能否在期中選舉前獲參議院通過並成為法律。
資料中心快速擴張之際，美國政壇對此議題的看法日漸複雜。川普強力支持資料中心發展，認為這對美國維持人工智慧(AI)領域的領導地位至關重要，例如他本周稍早表示，資料中心能讓民眾及各州變得富有，並稱資料中心是「未來20、25年的石油」。
但另一方面，民主、共和兩黨議員都面臨選民對資料中心產業用電需求激增、導致電費上漲的疑慮日益升高，甚至讓兩黨近期在資料中心議題上出現難得的共識。

共和黨候選人開始與川普唱反調

俄亥俄州共和黨聯邦參議員Jon Husted就是其中一個突出的例子。他在擔任俄亥俄州副州長期間，曾歡迎資料中心進駐該州，如今他的立場已轉向強調自己支持《電費支付者保護法案》。
Husted今年7月底在參議院提出這項法案，目標是確保美國民眾不必為新資料中心所需的電力買單。他也強調支持地方決策權。
Husted上周接受電視訪問時表示，「企業有責任為當地民眾做正確的事，否則當地民眾就應該告訴他們『不』。我的立場是，這應該由當地民眾決定。」
Husted立場轉變，恰好就發生在民主黨競選對手、前聯邦參議員Sherrod Brown於7月初展開廣告攻勢後。Brown在廣告中指控Husted多年來「積極招攬資料中心」進駐俄州。
共和黨參議院競選機構全國共和黨參議院委員會(NRSC)8月中旬在一份備忘錄中警告，資料中心是「掛在Husted脖子上的錨」，並呼籲需要資料中心的企業「改變俄州民眾對它們的看法」。
Bowling Green State University西北俄亥俄州分校政治學教授Melissa Miller表示，NRSC可能「誇大了資料中心在俄州參議院選舉中的重要性」，但她補充，這項議題對選民仍很重要，因為資料中心非常醒目，即使其重要性可能不及汽油價格或其他必需品。
Miller說：「如果你的郡、社區或上班途中有一座資料中心，你就會看到它們——它們如此龐大，你不可能看不到。」
除了俄亥俄州，資料中心議題也蔓延至其他競爭激烈的參議院選戰。

從密西根到德州

川普並未放棄長期支持AI及資料中心的立場，但有時也表示，共和黨員表達反對資料中心的立場並無不妥。
川普8月中旬曾說，「如果共和黨人反對資料中心，我沒有意見。」但他同時也表示，「一般而言，如果我管理一個社區，是市長或州長，我會希望擁有資料中心，因為它們能帶來巨額收入。它們很乾淨，會自行生產能源——新建的資料中心會自行生產能源。」
在某些時候，川普的態度就沒有那麼寬容。他8月底在社群媒體發文表示，如果社區不歡迎資料中心，最終「將變得落後且貧窮」。
到了本周一，川普又表示，他認為AI及資料中心正面臨一場「病態陰謀」，而唯一對此感到高興的是中國。這番言論發表前一天，AI巨頭紛紛表示支持放慢尖端AI模型的開發速度，不過，AI巨頭並未支持放慢資料中心建設。
川普之所以捍衛資料中心，是因為AI產業已成為美國經濟及股市的重要驅動力。川普也強調，AI發展對美國與中國競爭至關重要。
儘管如此，共和黨員仍在資料中心議題上與該黨領導人出現分歧。
根據賓州大學安納伯格公共政策中心(Annenberg Public Policy Center)上月公布的民調結果，61%的美國民眾有些或強烈反對在自己所在地興建新的資料中心，高於約四個月前的49%。其中民主黨選民反對比率為69%、共和黨選民為54%、獨立選民為53%。
賓州大學政治學與傳播學教授Matt Levendusky表示，「兩黨的反應確實非常引人注目——如今你已經很難在許多議題上看到這種情況。」
Levendusky指出相關論述的關鍵：這些設施帶來的好處將由「少數企業和億萬富豪」享有，而成本則由「接納資料中心的社區」或「因AI而失去工作機會的白領」承擔。
賓州大學民調發現，美國民眾平均認為AI唯一能帶來幫助的領域是醫學研究。
在密西根州這場競爭激烈的參議院選舉中，民主黨候選人Abdul El-Sayed已對AI議題採取強硬立場。共和黨對手、前聯邦眾議員Mike Rogers隨後宣布支持暫停該州資料中心建設一年。
德州參議院選舉也出現以資料中心議題為中心的角力。德州與密州、俄州的參議院選戰，都被《庫克政治報告》(Cook Political Report)列為「五五波」(toss-up)。
共和黨候選人、德州檢察長Ken Paxton上月提出一項計畫，主張取消資料中心的租稅優惠、禁止在鄉村社區興建資料中心，並要求資料中心自行負擔所需電力成本。
民主黨候選人James Talarico則抨擊Paxton過去擔任州議員時曾投票「透過提供數十億美元的租稅優惠，讓資料中心大量進駐德州」，並表示這名共和黨候選人如今「正試圖悲哀的改弦更張」。
共和黨對資料中心的反彈可能進一步升溫，賓州大學的Levendusky表示，「如果到了2028年，所有候選人都沒有開始提出他們將如何處理AI、希望如何監管AI的計畫，我會感到非常驚訝。這將成為未來政治的一部分。」

消費者團體質疑效果

消費者權益非營利組織Public Citizen則表示，這項立法不足以充分保護美國民眾。該組織能源計畫主管Tyson Slocum說：「《電費支付者保護法案》保護消費者免受公用事業費率上漲的能力，實際上非常有限，因為它只是要求各州『考量』是否要求資料中心支付部分電網接入成本。」
他表示，聯邦政府要求各州考量採取這項措施，確實為倡議人士爭取消費者保護提供機會，但資料中心帶來的其他許多消費者及社區影響，都沒有在這項法案中獲得處理。

items.title: 日本內閣首設「熊類管控大臣」 專責因應嚴峻熊害危機
items.title_en: Japan's Cabinet First Establishes a 'Bear Control Minister' to Tackle Growing Bear Damage Crisis
paras: 因應近年頻發且日益嚴重的熊隻襲擊與致命意外，日本政府於第2次高市改造內閣的人事布局中，正式增設專門負責熊類被害對策的內閣大臣職務。
新任環境大臣笹川博義獲任命兼任此一首創的「熊類管控大臣」（bear control czar），並同時負責核能緊急應變事務。日本政府設立此專責職位，反映出國內對熊害威脅劇增的深切疑慮與高度關切。
根據官方統計數據，截至今年3月的統計年度內，全日本目擊熊隻的次數暴增至50,776起，不僅呈現急遽成長，更超過了此前兩年目擊次數的總和。此外，襲擊事件造成的傷亡創下歷史新高，遭熊襲受傷人數高達238人，而死亡人數則從前一年的3人驟增至13人。
針對熊隻頻繁出沒並引發人熊衝突的原因，日本政府歸因於多重社會與環境因素。其中包括農村人口老齡化導致農民棄耕，荒廢的農地成為吸引熊隻前來覓食的誘因；同時，日本國內獵人總數的持續減少，也削弱了對野生熊隻族群的監控與數量抑制能力。
日本政府期盼透過設立專責閣員，強化個別政策與危機處理的橫向聯繫，針對農地管理與野生動物應變機制提出更具體的對策，以積極因應日益嚴峻的熊害威脅。
paras_en: In response to the increasingly frequent and severe bear attacks and fatal incidents in recent years, the Japanese government added a dedicated cabinet minister position for bear damage countermeasures in the personnel lineup of the second Takashi‑Kawasaki reshuffled cabinet.

New Environment Minister Hiroyoshi Sasagawa was appointed to also serve as the inaugural "Bear Control Minister" and will simultaneously handle nuclear emergency response matters. The creation of this dedicated role reflects deep domestic concern over the sharply rising threat of bear damage.

According to official statistics, in the fiscal year ending March this year, sightings of bears across Japan surged to 50,776 incidents—more than the total number recorded in the previous two years combined. Bear‑related injuries also hit a historic high, with 238 people wounded and deaths jumping from three the year before to 13.

The government attributes the frequent bear appearances and resulting human‑bear conflicts to multiple social and environmental factors, including an aging rural population that leads to abandoned farmland, which attracts bears seeking food, and a continual decline in the number of hunters, weakening monitoring and population control of wild bears.

By establishing a dedicated cabinet minister, the Japanese government hopes to strengthen cross‑ministerial coordination of policies and crisis management, develop more concrete measures for farmland management and wildlife response mechanisms, and proactively address the escalating bear damage threat.

items.title: AI資料中心擴張踢到鐵板矽谷居民反彈、加州擬收緊電力與用水規範
items.title_en: AI Data Center Expansion Hits Roadblock as Silicon Valley Residents Push Back, California Plans Tighter Power and Water Regulations
paras: 2026年09月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ AI資料中心建設熱潮正在矽谷遭遇地方阻力。加州聖荷西積極爭取AI資料中心投資，但居民與環保團體對龐大電力、用水及柴油備援發電機造成的污染疑慮升高，加州議會也已通過多項相關法案，要求大型用電戶承擔相應電網成本，並提高能源與用水資訊透明度，目前等待州長Gavin Newsom決定是否簽署。
聖荷西是加州第三大城市，人口接近100萬。市府去年與太平洋瓦斯電力PG&E(PCG-US)達成協議，加快向資料中心等大型用電戶提供電力，希望將城市打造為AI基礎設施重鎮。市府估計，每新增一座資料中心，每年可帶來300萬至600萬美元稅收，用於警消、圖書館、道路與公園等公共服務。
但AI資料中心帶來的資源消耗也引發反彈。當地居民要求新專案在核准前接受更嚴格的公共審查，並提高電力、用水以及健康與環境影響資訊透明度。聖荷西市長Matt Mahan表示，問題並非停止資料中心開發，而是如何在不推高居民電費、消耗潔淨水源或降低生活品質的情況下進行建設。
電力成本已成為政策焦點。加州州議會近期通過多項資料中心相關法案，包括要求大型用電戶負擔其應承擔的電網成本，以及提高能源與用水資訊揭露。Newsom必須在9月底前決定簽署或否決相關法案。
備援電力也受到關注。今年4月，環保團體已要求灣區空氣品質管理機構加強監管資料中心使用的柴油Backup Battery Unit以外之備援發電設備，認為現行規範制定時間早於這一波AI資料中心快速擴張，相關單位目前正評估是否需要提高監管標準。
這場爭議反映AI基礎設施擴張的瓶頸正從GPU、伺服器進一步向「電力、電網、用水與環境許可」延伸。包括Google、Meta Platforms(META-US)、OpenAI與Anthropic等AI業者均推動大量基礎設施投資，但隨資料中心規模與用電量提高，地方政府能否取得電力、完成電網升級並取得社區支持，正成為新專案能否落地的另一項關鍵條件。

paras_en: September 17, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center Report) – The AI data‑center construction boom is running into local resistance in Silicon Valley. San Jose, California is actively courting AI data‑center investment, but residents and environmental groups are raising concerns about the massive electricity, water use and diesel backup generators’ pollution. The state legislature has already passed several related bills requiring large power users to shoulder grid costs and to increase transparency on energy and water information, now awaiting Governor Gavin Newsom’s decision on whether to sign them.

San Jose, the third‑largest city in California with a population close to one million, struck a deal last year with Pacific Gas & Electric (PG&E, PCG‑US) to accelerate power delivery to large users such as data centers, hoping to turn the city into an AI‑infrastructure hub. The city estimates that each new data center could generate $3 million to $6 million in annual tax revenue for services such as police, fire, libraries, roads and parks.

But the resource consumption of AI data centers has sparked backlash. Local residents are demanding stricter public review before project approval and greater transparency on electricity, water, and health and environmental impact information. San Jose Mayor Matt Mahan said the issue is not to halt data‑center development but to build them without raising residents’ electricity bills, depleting clean water supplies or lowering quality of life.

Power costs have become a policy focus. The California State Legislature recently passed several data‑center‑related bills, including requirements that large power users bear the grid costs they impose and that energy and water information be disclosed more fully. Newsom must decide by the end of September whether to sign or veto the measures.

Backup power is also under scrutiny. In April, environmental groups asked Bay Area air‑quality regulators to tighten oversight of diesel backup generators used by data centers, arguing that existing rules were written before the rapid AI data‑center expansion and that agencies are now evaluating whether stricter standards are needed.

The dispute highlights that bottlenecks in AI infrastructure expansion are moving from GPUs and servers to “power, grid, water and environmental permits.” Companies such as Google, Meta Platforms (META‑US), OpenAI and Anthropic are pushing massive infrastructure investments, but as data‑center size and electricity demand grow, local governments’ ability to secure power, upgrade grids and gain community support is becoming a critical condition for new projects.

items.title: 英特爾示警記憶體短缺恐再惡化價格已漲5至7倍、AI基礎設施再卡電力與散熱
items.title_en: Intel Warns Memory Shortage May Worsen Further, Prices Up 5‑7×, AI Infrastructure Hampered by Power and Cooling
paras: 2026年09月17日（優分析／產業數據中心報導）⸺ I基礎設施快速擴張正讓半導體供應鏈面臨更多實體瓶頸。英特爾Intel(INTC-US)執行長陳立武表示，全球記憶體供應緊張情況可能進一步惡化，部分產業專案已因記憶體不足被迫延後，部分記憶體產品價格更已上漲至原先的5至7倍。
陳立武指出，記憶體產能限制已開始影響實際專案進度，其中中低階智慧型手機與筆記型電腦的記憶體供應壓力尤其明顯。他表示，早在2025年初便曾警示記憶體可能成為產業發展的重要限制，如今供應緊張已經浮現，後續壓力可能持續增加。
除了記憶體，電力與散熱也成為AI基礎設施擴張的兩大限制。陳立武表示，隨運算功耗提高，晶片設計、系統架構與元件互連的重要性同步上升；散熱技術也從傳統氣冷逐步延伸至液冷、微流體冷卻等新方案，英特爾已針對部分相關技術進行投資。
AI競爭模式也正從單一晶片轉向整個機櫃系統。陳立武指出，輝達NVIDIA(NVDA-US)、超微AMD(AMD-US)均嘗試整合GPU、CPU、網路硬體及軟體，以一體化機櫃系統切入市場。英特爾也將在基板領域推出新進展，並從整機機櫃層級處理運算負載及客戶客製化需求。

paras_en: September 17, 2026 (U-Analysis/Industry Data Center report) – Rapid expansion of AI infrastructure is creating more physical bottlenecks in the semiconductor supply chain. Intel (INTC‑US) CEO Pat Gelsinger said global memory supply tightness could worsen, forcing some industry projects to be delayed due to insufficient memory, and prices for certain memory products have already risen to five to seven times their previous levels.

Gelsinger noted that memory capacity constraints are already affecting project timelines, with the pressure most evident for mid‑range and low‑end smartphones and laptops. He said he warned as early as early 2025 that memory could become a major limiting factor for industry growth; the tightness is now materializing and the pressure is likely to keep increasing.

Beyond memory, power and cooling are becoming the two biggest constraints on AI infrastructure expansion. Gelsinger said that as compute power consumption rises, the importance of chip design, system architecture and component interconnects grows in tandem; cooling technology is also moving from traditional air cooling toward liquid cooling, micro‑fluidic cooling and other new solutions, and Intel has begun investing in several of these technologies.

The AI competition model is shifting from single chips to whole‑rack systems. Gelsinger pointed out that NVIDIA (NVDA‑US) and AMD (AMD‑US) are both trying to integrate GPUs, CPUs, networking hardware and software into integrated rack solutions. Intel will also introduce new advances in substrate technology and address compute loads and customer customization at the full‑rack level.

items.title: 〈台幣〉股匯雙漲 中止連5黑收31.881元
items.title_en: TWD Dual Rise in Stocks and Forex, Ends Five-Day Decline, Closes at 31.881
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)一如預期升息 1 碼，市場觀望台灣央行是否跟進，使得整體匯市交投冷清，新台幣兌美元匯率今(17)日一度失守 31.9 元，終場收在31.881元，微升0.7分，中止連 5 黑，台北外匯市場成交量 10.67 億美元。
Fed 升息利空出盡，台股今天開高走高，一度大漲千點，隨後漲幅收斂，終場上漲 439.1 點，收在 46288 點，站回月線。權王台積電終場上漲 45 元，收在 2425 元。外資回頭買超台股 121.85 億元。
台北股匯今天同步走揚，新台幣兌美元開盤價為31.91元，最高31.866元、最低31.958元，終場收在31.881元，微升0.7分。
Fed官員一致決議升息 1 碼，將基準利率調高至 3.75% 至 4%，為 2023 年 7 月以來首次升息。主席華許指出，升息主要基於三大關鍵因素，包括近期數據顯示美國基礎經濟成長超乎預期、勞動市場表現依然穩健，以及通膨持續居高不下且地緣政治局勢改變了經濟展望。FOMC 認為基礎通膨尚未明確朝 2% 目標下降，因此決定調高利率以展現壓制物價的決心。
最新點狀圖顯示，大多數官員預期年底前可能還會再升息 1 碼，但華許拒絕提供明確的前瞻指引，強調未來的政策行動將完全取決於最新經濟數據，保留後續調整彈性。此偏鷹派的表態直接衝擊金融市場，導致美股急跌翻黑、美債殖利率回升、美元大幅走強，黃金價格則隨之承壓重挫。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised rates by one quarter point as expected, and the market is watching whether Taiwan’s central bank will follow suit, leaving overall foreign‑exchange trading subdued. The New Taiwan dollar slipped past NT$31.9 per US$ on the 17th before finishing at NT$31.881, a modest rise of 0.7 points, ending a streak of five consecutive down days. The Taipei foreign‑exchange market saw a turnover of US$1.067 billion.

With the Fed’s rate hike fully priced in, Taiwan’s stock market opened higher and surged early, at one point jumping a thousand points before the gains narrowed. It closed up 439.1 points at 46,288, back above the monthly moving average. Chip‑maker TSMC added NT$45 to finish at NT$2,425. Foreign investors turned net buyers, purchasing NT$121.85 billion of Taiwanese equities.

The Taipei stock and forex markets rose in tandem today. The New Taiwan dollar opened at NT$31.91 per US$, peaked at NT$31.866, hit a low of NT$31.958, and closed at NT$31.881, a slight increase of 0.7 points.

Fed officials unanimously voted to raise the policy rate by one quarter point, moving the target range to 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023. Chair Jerome Powell said the move was driven by three key factors: recent data showing U.S. core economic growth exceeding expectations, a still‑robust labor market, and persistently high inflation amid changing geopolitical outlooks. The FOMC concluded that core inflation has not yet clearly moved toward the 2% goal, prompting the rate increase to demonstrate resolve on price stability.

The latest dot‑plot shows most officials expect another quarter‑point hike before year‑end, but Powell declined to give explicit forward guidance, stressing that future policy will depend entirely on incoming economic data and keeping flexibility for further adjustments. This hawkish tone hit financial markets hard, sending U.S. equities sharply lower, U.S. Treasury yields higher, the dollar stronger, and gold prices under pressure with a steep decline.

items.title: 〈央行理監事會〉利率連10凍、對房市鬆綁 楊金龍不跟進美國升息：走自己的路
items.title_en: <Central Bank Board Meeting> Interest Rates Frozen for the 10th Time, Housing Market Restrictions Eased; Governor Yang Jin‑long Won’t Follow U.S. Rate Hikes: Going Its Own Way
paras: 儘管美國聯準會甫宣布升息1碼(25個基點)，台灣是否跟進引發國內各界討論，但台灣央行今 (17) 日召開第三季理監事會議，仍宣布利率「連 10 凍」，央行總裁楊金龍說，「我們走我們的路」；同時，此次央行放鬆對房市的選擇性信用管制措施，調整自然人第2戶購屋貸款最高成數上限，由6成調升為7成。
央行發布最新重貼現率、擔保放款融通利率和短期融通利率分別為 2%、2.375% 和 4.25%，維持利率不變。
央行表示，今年國內通膨尚屬可控，明年可望回降至2%以下，同時，預期國內經濟穩健成長，為審慎因應全球經濟金融前景不確定性，以及中東衝突效應對國內物價與經濟可能影響，理事會認為本次維持政策利率不變，有助整體經濟金融穩健發展。
不過，楊金龍表示，將密切觀察國內通膨發展、主要經濟體貨幣政策緊縮程度、國內金融情勢，以及其他不確定性因素如AI應用前景、美國經貿政策衝擊及極端氣候等對國內經濟的影響，適時調整貨幣政策，以達成維持物價穩定和金融穩定。
外界解讀，此可能是後續央行啟動升息的訊號。
而美國聯準會周三(16日)宣布升息1碼，將基準利率上調至 3.75% 至 4.00% 區間，目標是緩和仍高於 2%的通膨壓力，美國總統川普對此表態，正面對一個「具敵意的理事會」。
paras_en: Despite the U.S. Federal Reserve’s recent 25‑basis‑point rate hike sparking debate in Taiwan over whether to follow suit, the Central Bank held its third‑quarter board meeting on the 17th and again announced that interest rates will remain frozen for the tenth consecutive meeting. Governor Yang Jin‑long said, “We will walk our own path.” At the same time, the bank relaxed selective credit controls on the housing market, raising the maximum loan‑to‑value ratio for a second home for individuals from 60% to 70%.
The Central Bank released its latest rates: the discount rate at 2.0%, the guaranteed loan financing rate at 2.375%, and the short‑term financing rate at 4.25%, leaving all rates unchanged.

The bank noted that domestic inflation remains manageable this year and is expected to fall below 2% next year. It also expects solid economic growth at home. To prudently address uncertainties in the global economic and financial outlook and the potential impact of Middle‑East conflicts on domestic prices and the economy, the board believes keeping the policy rate unchanged supports overall economic and financial stability.

Governor Yang added that the bank will closely monitor domestic inflation developments, the tightening of major economies’ monetary policies, domestic financial conditions, and other uncertain factors such as AI application prospects, U.S. trade policy shocks, and extreme weather, adjusting monetary policy as needed to maintain price and financial stability.
Observers interpret this as a possible signal that the Central Bank may initiate rate hikes in the future.

The U.S. Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday the 16th a 25‑basis‑point increase, raising the target range to 3.75%‑4.00% to ease inflation pressures that remain above 2%. President Trump commented on the move, describing the Fed as a “hostile board.”

items.title: 儘管通膨升溫 英國央行預計維持利率不變
items.title_en: Despite Rising Inflation, the Bank of England Expected to Keep Rates Unchanged
paras: 儘管英國8月消費者物價指數(CPI)年增率由7月的2.9%攀升至3.1%，進一步偏離英國央行設定的2%目標，市場普遍預期貨幣政策委員會(MPC)仍將以多數決將基準利率維持在3.75%，這將是央行連續第六次按兵不動。
本次通膨回升主要受到伊朗衝突引發的油氣價格飆漲，以及荷姆茲海峽航運受阻影響，推升了汽油與機票價格。隨著10月國內家庭能源帳單即將調漲，短期內物價壓力恐難緩解。
針對利率政策方向，專家與央行內部呈現明確分歧。施羅德全球經濟主管 David Rees 認為勞動市場與薪資成長依然溫和，他指出：「這應能限制進口價格壓力嵌入國內薪資與物價的程度」，因而支持央行暫時維持利率不變。
英國央行首席經濟學家 Huw Pill 則強烈反對「觀望態度」。他在演說中主張升息至4%，並警告：「不確定性可能無法如預期般快速解決，進而導致利率設定出現『現狀偏誤』，讓貨幣政策在因應通膨風險時『落後於曲線』」。此前，委員 Megan Greene 與 Catherine Mann 也曾投票支持升息至4%。
在美國聯準會(Fed)與歐洲央行(ECB)陸續調整政策之際，掉期市場預估英國央行可能於11月或12月啟動升息。由於首相柏南(Andy Burnham)政府將於10月底提出秋季預算案，央行傾向先觀察財政政策細節。而升息預期已帶動房貸利率上揚，也加重了政府的債務利息負擔。
paras_en: Despite the UK’s August Consumer Price Index (CPI) annual rate climbing from 2.9% in July to 3.1%, further away from the Bank of England’s 2% target, markets broadly expect the Monetary Policy Committee (MPC) to vote overwhelmingly to keep the Bank Rate at 3.75%, marking the sixth consecutive meeting of policy hold.

The latest inflation bounce is mainly driven by soaring oil and gas prices triggered by the Iran conflict and shipping disruptions in the Hormuz Strait, which have pushed up gasoline and airfare costs. With domestic household energy bills set to rise in October, price pressures are unlikely to ease in the short term.

On the direction of rate policy, experts and insiders at the Bank show a clear split. David Rees, Global Head of Economics at Schroders, argues that the labour market and wage growth remain moderate, noting, “This should limit the extent to which imported price pressures feed into domestic wages and inflation,” and therefore backs a temporary pause on rate hikes.

Bank of England chief economist Huw Pill strongly opposes a “wait‑and‑see” stance. In his speech he advocated raising rates to 4% and warned, “Uncertainty may not be resolved as quickly as expected, leading to a ‘status‑quo bias’ in rate setting that could leave monetary policy lagging behind the inflation curve.” Previously, MPC members Megan Greene and Catherine Mann also voted for a hike to 4%.

As the US Federal Reserve and the European Central Bank adjust their policies, the swaps market estimates the Bank of England could start raising rates in November or December. Since Prime Minister Andy Burnham’s government will present its autumn budget at the end of October, the Bank prefers to first observe fiscal details. The rate‑rise expectations have already pushed up mortgage rates, adding to the government’s debt‑service burden.

items.title: 聯準會鷹派升息重壓日元 日本央行面臨「走鋼索」考驗
items.title_en: Fed's Hawkish Rate Hikes Pressure Yen; BOJ Faces a "Tightrope" Test
paras: 美國聯準會周三(16日)升息，並預估明年年中前將再升息三次，導致美日利差持續擴大，重挫日元走勢。儘管日本央行(BOJ)預計於周五升息，但市場警告，若官方未能釋出明確的緊縮訊號，日元恐將進一步受挫。
在聯準會決議後，美元兌日元一度貶至 156.42。墨爾本 ACCM 研究總監 Glenn Yin 指出，日本正面臨巨大壓力，必須同時升息並傳遞鷹派訊息以減輕損害；若日本央行政策令人失望，匯率快速下探 160 關卡將是無法排除的風險。
目前隔夜指數交換(OIS)已幾乎完全反映升息 1 碼(25 個基點)的預期，焦點轉向總裁植田和男會後的發言，鷹派審議委員高田創對大幅升息或連續升息抱持開放態度。
SMBC 日興證券高級策略師Rinto Maruyama指出，日元回落與油價上漲為官方強調通膨風險提供了理由，但若會議被解讀為鴿派，美元兌日元下一目標將看 158，長期不排除重返 160。
青空銀行(Aozora Bank)首席市場策略師Akira Moroga警告，日本央行的緊縮立場可能不如聯準會鷹派，這恐成為日元弱勢的即時催化劑，下個關鍵門檻落在 200 日均線附近的 158.50。
此外，匯市干預風險再次升溫。日本財務省數據顯示，截至 8 月 26 日止的一個月中，日本耗資創紀錄的 15.4 兆日元進行干預，美國財政部長貝森特(Scott Bessent)持續釋出支持強勢日元的訊號。
花旗集團策略師Osamu Takashima等人認為，雖然短期美元兌日元可能反彈至 159，但長期而言，多次干預與日本國債吸引力提升將推動體制轉變，日元拋售潮預計將不如過往激烈。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve raised rates on Wednesday (the 16th) and projected three more hikes before mid‑next year, widening the U.S.–Japan interest‑rate gap and sharply weakening the yen. Although the Bank of Japan (BOJ) is expected to raise rates on Friday, markets warn that if the BOJ fails to deliver a clear tightening signal, the yen could be hit even harder.

After the Fed decision, the dollar fell as low as ¥156.42 per dollar. Glenn Yin, research director at Melbourne‑based ACCM, said Japan is under huge pressure and must raise rates while sending a hawkish message to limit damage; if BOJ policy disappoints, a rapid slide toward the ¥160 barrier cannot be ruled out.

Overnight indexed swap (OIS) rates now almost fully price in a one‑tick (25‑basis‑point) hike, shifting focus to the remarks of Governor Kazuo Ueda after the meeting, while hawkish committee member Hiroshi Takata remains open to large or consecutive hikes.

Rinto Maruyama, senior strategist at SMBC Nikko Securities, noted that the yen’s decline and rising oil prices give officials a reason to stress inflation risks, but if the meeting is read as dovish, the next target for USD/JPY will be around 158, with a long‑term possibility of returning to 160.

Akira Moroga, chief market strategist at Aozora Bank, warned that the BOJ’s tightening stance may be less hawkish than the Fed’s, which could become an immediate catalyst for yen weakness, with the next critical threshold near the 200‑day moving average at ¥158.50.

In addition, the risk of currency‑market intervention has risen again. Ministry of Finance data show that in the month ending August 26, Japan spent a record ¥15.4 trillion on interventions, while U.S. Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent continues to signal support for a stronger yen.

Citigroup strategists led by Osamu Takashima believe that although the dollar‑yen pair may bounce to ¥159 in the short term, in the longer run repeated interventions and the growing appeal of Japanese government bonds will drive a structural shift, and the yen‑selling pressure is expected to be less intense than in the past.

items.title: 香港金管局隨Fed上調基本利率 余偉文：民眾需充分考量並管理利率風險
items.title_en: Hong Kong Monetary Authority Raises Base Rate in Line with Fed; Yu Wai-man Says Public Must Fully Consider and Manage Interest Rate Risk
paras: 美國聯準會(Fed)周三(16日)宣布上調聯邦基金利率目標區間25個基點至3.75%—4.00%後，香港金融管理局(金管局)隨即宣布，依據預設公式將基本利率上調25個基點至4.25%，即時生效。
金管局此舉旨在緊貼美方升息步伐，以維持港元聯繫匯率制度。
然而，香港主要商業銀行包括滙豐銀行、中國銀行(香港)及渣打銀行(香港)均宣布維持港元最優惠利率不變，分別保持在5%與5.25%。不過，滙豐自9月18日起將美元儲蓄存款戶口利率上調12.4個基點至0.125%。
針對升息影響，金管局總裁余偉文表示，上調利率符合市場預期。他分析，港美息差進一步擴大可能引發套利交易，導致港元逐步走弱。余偉文特別提醒，美國利率走向仍具不確定性，民眾在做出購屋房貸、投資或借貸決定時，需充分考量並管理利率風險。
中銀香港高級經濟研究員曾之騰指出，本次升息已獲市場充分定價，聲明顯示聯準會正更加聚焦於通膨偏離目標的幅度與持續時間；同時美債長端殖利率「易上難下」，需警惕其推高全球融資成本的風險。
奧雅納董事王兆麒認為，升息將增加現有購屋族負擔並削弱購買力，部分準買家或將「轉買為租」。他預估香港房市下半年將出現「價量齊跌」，2026年餘下時間房價將反覆向下。
嘉信理財香港高級副總裁林長傑補充，本次決策顯示聯準會傾向預先抑制通膨風險，市場原先預期於2027年啟動降息循環的可能性正隨之下降。
paras_en: The U.S. Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday (the 16th) that it is raising the target range for the federal funds rate by 25 basis points to 3.75%‑4.00%, and the Hong Kong Monetary Authority immediately announced that, according to its preset formula, the base rate will be raised by 25 basis points to 4.25% and will take effect instantly.
The move by the Monetary Authority is intended to stay closely aligned with the U.S. rate‑hiking pace in order to maintain the linked exchange‑rate system for the Hong Kong dollar.

However, Hong Kong’s major commercial banks—including HSBC, Bank of China (Hong Kong) and Standard Chartered Bank (Hong Kong) – have all said they will keep their best‑rate HKD lending rates unchanged at 5% and 5.25% respectively. HSBC, however, will raise the interest rate on its U.S. dollar savings accounts by 12.4 basis points to 0.125% starting September 18.

Regarding the rate‑hike impact, Monetary Authority chief executive Yu Wai-man said the increase is in line with market expectations. He warned that a further widening of the HK‑US interest‑rate spread could trigger arbitrage trades that would gradually weaken the Hong Kong dollar. Yu stressed that the trajectory of U.S. rates remains uncertain, and that the public should fully consider and manage interest‑rate risk when making decisions about home mortgages, investments or borrowing.

Bank of China (Hong Kong) senior economist Zeng Zhiteng noted that the hike has already been fully priced in by the market, indicating that the Fed is focusing more on the magnitude and duration of inflation deviating from its target; at the same time, long‑term U.S. Treasury yields are “easy to rise but hard to fall,” and the risk that they could push up global financing costs should be watched.

O’Yana director Wang Zhaoqi believes the rate increase will increase the burden on existing home‑buyers and erode purchasing power, causing some prospective buyers to “switch from buying to renting.” He forecasts that Hong Kong’s housing market will see “price and volume falling together” in the second half of the year, and that house prices will continue to decline intermittently through the remainder of 2026.

Charles Schwab Hong Kong senior vice‑president Lin Changjie added that the decision shows the Fed’s inclination to pre‑emptively curb inflation risk, reducing the market’s earlier expectation of a rate‑cut cycle starting in 2027.

items.title: 日銀跟進Fed升1碼已計價！專家：支撐日元面臨更高門檻 明天會後指引若不鷹恐再測160
items.title_en: BOJ Follows Fed’s 1‑Basis‑Point Hike Already Priced In! Experts Say Support for Yen Faces Higher Hurdles; If Post‑Meeting Guidance Isn’t Hawkish, Yen May Test 160 Again
paras: 聯準會(Fed)週三(16日)宣布將聯邦基金利率目標區間升息1碼至3.75%-4%，為2023年7月以來首見且釋出進一步緊縮訊號，市場已將明年年中前再升息3次納入預期，對此專家認為Fed最新舉措將讓週五(19日)日本央行(BOJ)升息支撐日元面臨更高門檻。
日元在美元走強下隔夜一度走貶近1%，觸及156.42。匯市策略師指出，即便BOJ按市場共識升息1碼，但若會後指引不夠鷹派，仍難抵銷美日利差擴大壓力。
墨爾本ACCM研究總監Glenn Yin表示，日本央行「既要升息、又要釋出鷹派信號」才能把日元損失降到最低，若結果令市場失望，短期向下測試160風險難除。
隔夜指數掉期數據幾乎完全反映1碼升幅，市場重心轉向BOJ總裁植田和男記者會。
鷹派審議委員高田創未排除大幅或連續加息；三井住友日興證券Rinto Maruyama則認為，預期升息後政策利率可進入中性區間估算值(約1.1%-2.5%)，因此BOJ不太可能暗示一次升息2碼或連續升，但若被解讀偏鴿，美元兌日元匯率將攀升至158，中長期若美債殖利率升速快於日本，則可能上看160。油價上漲推升輸入型通膨，也給BOJ強調通膨上行風險提供理由。
不過，新一輪賣壓恐低於以往。根據CFTC數據顯示，在8日為止一週，槓桿交易員日元空頭較前期減半，套利交易因本月初日元反彈已部分平倉，日本退休基金回補國內資產的預期亦降低單邊做空意願。美日聯合干預的威脅同樣形成下限，美國財長貝森特持續釋出支持日元走強訊號。
青空銀行首席市場策略師諸岡晃(Akira Moroga)則提醒，BOJ很難採取與Fed同等鷹派立場，若僅溫和升息、缺乏後續路徑，158.5(接近200日線)將成下個關鍵。
整體來看，明日決議本身已大致被市場消化，真正主導日元的是總裁植田和男記者會對未來每季緊縮節奏的表態，以及美日利差重新定價的速度。
paras_en: The Federal Reserve announced on Wednesday (the 16th) that it will raise the target range for the federal funds rate by one basis point to 3.75%‑4%, the first hike since July 2023 and a signal of further tightening. Markets have already priced in three more hikes by mid‑next year, and experts say the Fed’s latest move will raise the bar for the Bank of Japan’s (BOJ) rate hike on Friday (the 19th) to support the yen.

The yen slipped nearly 1% overnight against a strengthening dollar, touching 156.42. Currency strategists note that even if the BOJ raises rates by one basis point in line with market consensus, a post‑meeting outlook that is not sufficiently hawkish will still struggle to offset the pressure from a widening US‑Japan rate differential.

Glenn Yin, research director at Melbourne’s ACCM, said the BOJ “needs to raise rates and send a hawkish signal” to minimise the yen’s losses. If the outcome disappoints the market, the risk of a short‑term test of the 160 level remains hard to dismiss.
Overnight index swap data almost fully reflected the one‑basis‑point hike, shifting market focus to BOJ Governor Kazuo Ueda’s press conference.

Hawkish policy‑board member Hiroshi Nakata did not rule out a large or consecutive rate increase; Mitsui Sumitomo Nikko Securities’ Rinto Maruyama believes that after a hike the policy rate could enter a neutral range (about 1.1%‑2.5%), so the BOJ is unlikely to signal a two‑basis‑point move or a series of hikes. However, if the tone is read as dovish, the USD/JPY rate could climb to 158, and in the medium‑to‑long term, if US Treasury yields rise faster than Japan’s, it could push toward 160. Rising oil prices are feeding import‑linked inflation, giving the BOJ further reason to stress upside inflation risks.

Nevertheless, the new round of selling pressure may be lower than before. CFTC data show that in the week ending the 8th, leveraged traders’ yen short positions were halved from the prior period, and arbitrage trades have been partially unwound after the yen’s rebound earlier this month. Expectations that Japanese pension funds will rebalance into domestic assets have also reduced unilateral short‑selling appetite. The threat of coordinated US‑Japan intervention also sets a floor, with US Treasury Secretary Janet Yellen continuing to signal support for a stronger yen.

Akira Moroga, chief market strategist at Aozora Bank, cautions that the BOJ can hardly adopt a stance as hawkish as the Fed’s. If it only delivers a modest hike without a clear forward path, the 158.5 level (near the 200‑day moving average) will become the next key threshold.

Overall, tomorrow’s decision has largely been priced in by the market. What will truly drive the yen is Governor Ueda’s press conference and his comments on the quarterly tightening pace, as well as the speed at which the US‑Japan rate differential is re‑priced.

items.title: 高盛改口！預期聯準會10月再升息25個基點 年底利率看向4%-4.25%
items.title_en: Goldman Sachs Reverses Stance, Anticipates Another 25‑Basis‑Point Rate Hike by the Fed in October, Year‑End Rates Targeted at 4%‑4.25%
paras: 高盛集團最新調整利率預測，現在預期美國聯準會將於10月政策會議再次升息25個基點，延續9月升息的步伐。高盛在最新報告中指出，10月是下一次升息最可能發生的時間點，因為聯準會若要透過連續會議升息，讓通膨更及時回到2%目標，10月將是較自然的政策行動時機。
聯準會周三(16日)宣布升息25個基點，將聯邦基金利率目標區間由3.50%-3.75%提高至3.75%-4.00%，這是聯準會自2023年7月以來首次升息。聯準會同時釋放未來數月可能進一步升息的訊號，顯示決策官員認為通膨仍處於偏高水準，政策仍需維持緊縮方向。
高盛目前預期，聯準會將在9月及10月連續兩次升息25個基點，使聯邦基金利率升至4.00%-4.25%。高盛認為，這樣的連續升息路徑符合聯準會希望讓通膨更及時回到2%目標的政策訊息，因此10月比12月更可能成為下一次升息時點。
聯準會最新公布的經濟預測也支持進一步升息的可能性。最新利率點陣圖顯示，政策制定者預期今年還會升息1次，之後在2027年維持利率不變，2028年才重新降息，2029年底聯邦基金利率預估落在3.50%-3.75%。
最新預測與6月時的政策展望相比出現變化。6月時，聯準會官員同樣預期2026年還有一次25個基點升息，但當時預估2027年還會降息25個基點；最新預測則改為今年再升息一次、2027年維持利率不變，反映決策官員對通膨降溫速度的預期更加謹慎。
通膨前景是聯準會重新轉向升息的重要原因。聯準會最新預測顯示，2026年個人消費支出價格指數(PCE)通膨率中位數預測由6月的3.6%上修至3.7%，2027年預估為2.3%，2028年為2.1%，並預計到2029年才回到2%的長期目標。
聯準會主席華許(Kevin Warsh)表示，通膨仍然過高，而且持續時間太長，夏季公布的通膨數據並未顯示核心通膨趨勢出現明顯改善。因此，聯準會目前仍將控制通膨視為主要政策焦點。
除了通膨之外，美國經濟活動仍具韌性，也降低聯準會立即放鬆政策的必要性。聯準會最新聲明指出，美國經濟活動仍以穩健速度擴張，生產力成長強勁，企業資本投資也保持韌性，這些因素使決策官員仍有空間維持較高利率。
聯準會最新經濟預測也顯示，政策制定者對經濟成長的看法略為改善，同時預期失業率仍維持在相對低的水準。在通膨尚未回到2%目標、經濟活動又沒有出現明顯疲弱的情況下，聯準會因此保留進一步升息的政策選項。
市場對再次升息的預期也快速升溫。聯準會公布利率決策及最新經濟預測後，投資人進一步押注今年底前仍有一次升息，利率市場的定價顯示，市場對聯準會持續收緊貨幣政策的預期明顯提高。
金融市場對9月升息的反應也相當明顯。聯準會公布決策後，美元走強，美國短天期公債殖利率上升，因2年期殖利率對聯準會政策利率預期最為敏感；長天期美債殖利率則相對穩定，使殖利率曲線進一步趨平。
高盛此次調整預測的關鍵，在於聯準會的政策討論已從是否開始升息，轉向下一次升息何時發生。由於9月升息已經實現，市場接下來將更加關注10月會議前公布的通膨、就業及經濟活動數據，尤其是價格壓力是否持續高於聯準會目標。
聯準會最新政策路徑也意味著高利率可能維持更長時間。最新預測顯示，2027年聯邦基金利率可能維持在4.00%-4.25%，2028年才開始回落，2029年底則預估降至3.50%-3.75%。這代表即使未來進入降息階段，利率仍可能長時間高於過去超低利率環境。
不過，華許並未提供自己的利率及經濟預測，他在會後記者會上強調，聯準會公布的經濟預測反映其他政策制定者的看法，而非他個人的預測，也沒有提供明確的前瞻性政策指引。因此，10月是否升息仍將取決於未來數週公布的經濟數據，而非目前任何單一機構的預測。
聯準會此次升息決策獲得一致支持，華許也加入投票。聯準會表示，通膨仍然偏高，且經濟活動保持穩健，因此需要進一步觀察政策對經濟及物價的影響。
在此背景下，高盛目前認為10月再次升息的可能性高於此前預期。若聯準會確實連續兩次升息，10月底聯邦基金利率將達到4.00%-4.25%，也將進一步確認美國貨幣政策重新進入緊縮階段。市場接下來將密切觀察通膨能否出現更明顯的降溫跡象，以及勞動市場與消費活動是否仍足以支撐聯準會延續升息路徑。
paras_en: Goldman Sachs Group has revised its rate outlook, now expecting the U.S. Federal Reserve to raise rates by another 25 basis points at its October policy meeting, continuing the pace set in September. In its latest report, Goldman notes that October is the most likely timing for the next hike, as a series of rate increases would help bring inflation back to the 2% target more promptly, making October a natural policy action point.

The Fed announced on Wednesday (the 16th) a 25‑basis‑point hike, moving the federal‑funds target range from 3.50%‑3.75% to 3.75%‑4.00%, its first increase since July 2023. The central bank also signaled that further hikes may follow in the coming months, indicating that policymakers still see inflation as elevated and that a tightening stance remains necessary.

Goldman now expects the Fed to deliver two consecutive 25‑basis‑point hikes in September and October, lifting the federal‑funds rate to 4.00%‑4.25%. The firm argues that this back‑to‑back path aligns with the Fed’s message of getting inflation back to 2% more quickly, making October more likely than December for the next move.

The Fed’s latest economic projections also support the possibility of further tightening. The newest dot‑plot shows policymakers anticipating one more hike this year, holding rates steady through 2027, with a first cut not expected until 2028, and a projected federal‑funds range of 3.50%‑3.75% by the end of 2029.

Compared with the June outlook, the latest forecast shows a shift. In June, officials expected another 25‑basis‑point hike in 2026 and a 25‑basis‑point cut in 2027. The new outlook replaces the 2027 cut with a rate‑hold, reflecting a more cautious view of how quickly inflation will cool.

Inflation outlook is a key driver of the Fed’s renewed tightening. The latest forecast raises the median personal consumption expenditures (PCE) inflation estimate for 2026 from 3.6% to 3.7%, with 2.3% projected for 2027, 2.1% for 2028, and a return to the 2% long‑run goal only by 2029.

Fed Chair Kevin Warsh said inflation remains too high and has persisted for too long; the summer inflation data did not show a clear improvement in core inflation trends. Consequently, controlling inflation remains the Fed’s primary policy focus.

Beyond inflation, U.S. economic activity remains resilient, reducing the need for an immediate policy easing. The Fed’s latest statement notes that the economy is expanding at a solid pace, productivity growth is strong, and corporate capital investment stays robust, giving policymakers room to keep rates elevated.

The Fed’s new economic projections also show a modest improvement in growth outlook and an expectation that unemployment will stay relatively low. With inflation still above the 2% target and no clear signs of economic weakness, the Fed retains the option of further hikes.

Market expectations for another hike have risen sharply. After the Fed released its rate decision and projections, investors doubled down on the view that another increase is likely before year‑end, and rate‑market pricing reflects a markedly higher expectation of continued monetary tightening.

Financial markets reacted noticeably to the September hike. Following the decision, the dollar strengthened and short‑term U.S. Treasury yields rose, with the two‑year yield being most sensitive to Fed policy expectations; longer‑term yields stayed relatively stable, flattening the yield curve further.

The key to Goldman’s forecast adjustment is that the Fed’s discussion has shifted from whether to start tightening to when the next hike will occur. With the September hike already priced in, markets will now focus on inflation, employment and activity data released before the October meeting, especially whether price pressures remain above the Fed’s target.

The Fed’s latest policy path also implies that high rates could persist longer. The new outlook suggests the federal‑funds rate may stay at 4.00%‑4.25% through 2027, only beginning to fall in 2028, and projected at 3.50%‑3.75% by the end of 2029. This means that even when the easing cycle starts, rates could remain well above the ultra‑low levels of recent years.

However, Warsh did not provide his own rate or economic forecasts; in his post‑meeting press conference he emphasized that the Fed’s projections reflect the views of other policymakers, not his personal outlook, and offered no explicit forward guidance. Thus, the October decision will depend on the economic data released in the coming weeks rather than any single institution’s forecast.

The rate‑hike decision received unanimous support from the Fed, with Warsh also voting. The Fed noted that inflation remains elevated and economic activity stays solid, warranting further observation of how policy impacts the economy and prices.

Against this backdrop, Goldman now sees a higher probability of another October hike than previously expected. If the Fed does deliver two consecutive hikes, the federal‑funds rate could reach 4.00%‑4.25% by the end of October, confirming that U.S. monetary policy has re‑entered a tightening phase. Markets will closely watch for clearer signs of inflation cooling and whether the labor market and consumer activity remain strong enough to sustain the Fed’s hike trajectory.

items.title: 【遠東商銀】FED如預期升息，擴大美元漲勢
items.title_en: [Far East Commercial Bank] Fed Raises Rates as Expected, Expanding Dollar Gains
paras: ◆USD/JPY

油價及美國公債收益率攀升，市場押注美國聯邦準備理事會(FED)本周升息，但美國財政部長貝森特表示與日本聯合干預日圓匯率成本適度，有利美國出口商和利率，而且美國原油庫存意外大增，週三導致油價回落，暫緩美元漲勢；此外，日本數據顯示7月核心機械訂單較前月跌3.7%及較上年同期增11.2%遜於預期，而且8月貿易逆差擴大至1.106兆日圓，但半導體相關需求堅挺，推動出口較上年同期攀升19.3%，為連續十二個月增長，同時油價上漲推高能源成本，進口較去年同期創2022年11月以來最大增幅28%，通貨膨脹壓力加劇，強化日本央行(BOJ)本週五升息的預期支撐日圓，美元兌日圓滑落154.86低點。
